blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Automated LOD3 building modeling typically relies on purpose-built geometric or learning-based pipelines, limiting flexibility across heterogeneous buildings and input evidence conditions.
This study investigates whether Astra, a general-purpose multimodal foundation model, can address these limitations through zero-shot reconstruction of LOD3 building models within an agentic framework under bounded autonomy.
AstraLOD3 combines multi-view images, calibrated cameras, and a filtered sparse SfM point cloud with a natural-language reconstruction specification, while the Astra agent dynamically selects and executes computational procedures using Python and Blender.
Across 35 runs, including 24 benchmark buildings, AstraLOD3 achieved a mean FRDS of 0.9647 and geometric agreement comparable to that of previous purpose-built methods. Controlled ablations further revealed the effects of reconstruction guidance, evidence modalities, model configuration, and run-to-run variability.
The results demonstrate that structured LOD3 reconstruction can be formulated as a constrained agentic process rather than as a fixed pipeline.
Future work will investigate adaptive refinement, user-guided correction, task-specific specialization, and damage-aware reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
自动LOD3大楼建模一般依靠专用的几何或基于学习的管道,限制了不同建筑物的灵活性和输入证据条件。
本研究调查了通用多式联运基础模型Astra是否能够通过在有限自主的代理框架内零镜头重建LOD3建筑模型来解决这些局限性。
AstraLOD3将多视图图像,校准相机,滤光的稀疏SfM点云与自然语言的重建规格相结合,而Astra代理则动态地使用Python和Blender选择并执行计算程序.
AstraLOD3在包括24座基准建筑物在内的35次运行中,实现了平均0.9647美元的FRDS和与以往目的建造方法类似的几何协议。 控制下的崩盘进一步揭示了重建指导、证据模式、模型配置和运行中变异性的影响。
结果表明,结构化的LOD3重建可以作为有限的代理过程而不是固定的管道进行。
今后的工作将调查适应性改进、用户指导的改正、具体任务的专门化和对损害的认识重建。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The digitalization of the built environment is increasingly important for supporting more efficient management of buildings and infrastructure throughout their life cycle. Digital representations of physical assets can facilitate activities ranging from planning and construction to operation, inspection, maintenance, renovation, and ultimately deconstruction and reuse [ 23 , 12 ] . By providing structured information about existing assets, such representations can support their visualization, documentation, analysis, and integration with data-driven workflows for asset management and decision-making [ 49 ] . As the number and diversity of existing assets requiring digital documentation continue to grow, scalable approaches for generating reliable digital representations of the built environment are therefore becoming increasingly important.
blocks.zh: 建筑环境数字化对于支持建筑物和基础设施在整个生命周期的更有效管理越来越重要。 有形资产的数字表示可以促进从规划和建造到运营、检查、维护、翻新以及最终拆除和再利用的活动[23、12]。 通过提供关于现有资产的结构化信息,这种表述可以支持其可视化、文件编制、分析和与资产管理和决策的数据驱动工作流程的整合[49]。 随着需要数字文件的现有资产的数量和多样性继续增加,建立可靠的建筑环境数字化表述的可扩展办法也变得越来越重要。

blocks.en: Among the different forms of digital representation, lightweight and geometrically structured 3D models provide an attractive compromise between geometric fidelity and model complexity. Rather than preserving all captured information indiscriminately, level-of-detail (LOD) representations can retain the geometric features required for a particular application while abstracting details that provide limited additional value for that purpose [ 2 ] . Such representations offer explicit and editable surfaces and architectural components, manageable geometric complexity, and efficient visualization and computation, while also reducing storage and data-transfer requirements. Moreover, organizing building geometry into identifiable components, such as walls, roofs, windows, doors, balconies, and other architectural elements, provides an object-level structure to which additional semantic or application-specific information can subsequently be associated [ 28 ] . These characteristics make lightweight structured models suitable as geometric foundations for a range of downstream workflows, including building information modeling, digital twins, asset documentation and management, numerical analysis, and urban-scale applications [ 34 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 在数字代表的不同形式中,轻量级和几何结构的立体模型提供了几何忠诚度和模型复杂性之间的有吸引力的妥协. 详细程度(LOD)的表述方式不是不加区别地保留所有获取的信息,而是可以保留特定应用所需的几何特征,同时抽象出为此目的提供有限额外价值的细节[2]。 这种表述提供了清晰和可编辑的表面和建筑构件、可管理的几何复杂性以及高效的可视化和计算,同时也减少了存储和数据传输要求。 此外,将建筑物几何结构组织成可识别的组成部分,如墙壁,屋顶,窗户,门,瓦房等建筑元素,提供了一种物体级结构,随后可以与之关联额外的语义或应用特定信息[28]. 这些特征使得轻量级结构模型适合作为一系列下游工作流程的几何基础,包括建筑信息模型,数字双胞胎,资产文献和管理,数字分析,以及城市规模应用[34,1].

blocks.en: Structured digital models of existing buildings have traditionally been produced through manual or semi-manual CAD modeling, a process that can require substantial human effort to interpret the physical asset and reproduce its geometry [ 44 ] . Reality-capture technologies have progressively reduced the need for direct manual measurement by providing dense visual and geometric observations of existing environments. In particular, image-based photogrammetry and Structure-from-Motion (SfM) can recover three-dimensional scene geometry together with calibrated camera poses from sets of overlapping images [ 40 ] , while laser scanning and LiDAR systems can directly acquire point-cloud representations of the observed geometry [ 37 ] . Nevertheless, reality capture itself remains constrained by factors such as accessibility, occlusions, acquisition time, sensor deployment, and incomplete observational coverage [ 36 ] . More importantly, the resulting images, camera geometry, and point clouds constitute observations of the physical asset rather than directly usable structured building models, and must therefore be transformed into compact and semantically organized representations suitable for subsequent engineering and built-environment applications [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有建筑的结构化数字模型传统上是通过人工或半人工CAD模型制作的,这一过程可能需要人类做出大量努力来解释物理资产并复制其几何学[44]. 现实捕捉技术通过对现有环境提供密集的视觉和几何观测,逐渐减少了直接人工测量的需要. 特别是基于图像的摄影测量和结构-从运动(SfM)可以恢复三维场景几何,同时从几组重叠的图像[40]中校准相机姿势,而激光扫描和LiDAR系统可以直接获得观测到几何的点-云表示[37]. 然而,现实捕捉本身仍然受到诸如可获取性、隔离性、获取时间、传感器部署以及观测覆盖不完整等因素的制约[36]。 更重要的是,由此产生的图像、照相机几何和点云构成对实物资产的观测,而不是直接可用的结构化建筑模型,因此,必须转化为紧凑的、有条理的、适于以后的工程和建筑环境应用的表述[47]。

blocks.en: Transforming reality-capture observations into structured building models nevertheless remains a challenging task. Conventional automated reconstruction methods commonly rely on combinations of data preprocessing, segmentation, geometric primitive extraction, model fitting, regularization, and component-specific reconstruction procedures [ 15 ] . Although such constraints can provide effective solutions for particular reconstruction scenarios, their performance often depends on predefined thresholds, geometric priors, and assumptions regarding building configuration, which can reduce flexibility when processing buildings with different architectural characteristics or observations affected by noise, sparsity, occlusion, and incomplete coverage [ 26 ] . Learning-based approaches can replace some manually designed reconstruction stages by learning geometric or semantic relationships from data [ 4 ] ; however, they generally require task-specific training data and their performance remains dependent on the distributions represented during training [ 22 ] . Consequently, generating detailed structured models from heterogeneous and incomplete observations often requires specialized algorithms, prior assumptions, and multiple processing stages, while the inference and completion of architectural elements that are only partially observed remain particularly challenging.
blocks.zh: 然而,把对现实的观察转变为结构化的建筑模式仍然是一项艰巨的任务。 常规自动化重建方法通常依靠数据预处理,分解,几何原始提取,模型配制,规范化,以及特定部件重建程序的组合[15]. 虽然这些制约因素可以为特定的重建情景提供有效的解决方案,但其性能往往取决于预先确定的阈值,几何前科,以及关于建筑配置的假设,这在处理具有不同建筑特征的建筑物或受到噪音,麻痹,隔离,以及覆盖不完整影响的建筑物时会降低灵活性[26]. 以学习为基础的方法可以通过从数据中学习几何或语义关系来取代一些人工设计的重建阶段;然而,这些方法通常需要针对具体任务的培训数据,其绩效仍然取决于培训期间的分布情况[22]。 因此,从不同和不完整的观测中生成详细的结构模型,往往需要专门的算法、以前的假设和多个处理阶段,而仅部分观测到的建筑要素的推论和完成仍然特别困难。

blocks.en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models provide a fundamentally different mechanism for addressing such heterogeneous reconstruction tasks. In contrast to conventional learning-based approaches designed and trained for a specific prediction task, general-purpose multimodal models can combine visual and language information within a common instruction-following framework [ 19 ] . When coupled with code generation and external computational tools, such models can translate high-level instructions into executable procedures and invoke available software functions [ 18 ] . In an agentic setting, these capabilities can support dynamic task decomposition, execution of intermediate operations, and iterative evaluation and refinement of their outputs [ 41 ] . Such systems can therefore operate not only as predictors of predefined outputs but also as goal-directed computational agents capable of selecting, composing, and revising executable actions according to observations obtained during task execution [ 45 ] . These emerging capabilities create the possibility of replacing parts of rigid, purpose-built reconstruction pipelines with flexible, evidence-driven workflows in which the procedure required to transform heterogeneous observations into a structured 3D representation is determined dynamically during execution.
blocks.zh: 多式联运基础模式最近的进展为解决这种多种多样的重建任务提供了一个根本不同的机制。 与为具体预测任务设计和培训的基于学习的常规方法不同,通用多式联运模型可以在共同的教学框架内结合视觉和语言信息[19]。 当结合代码生成和外部计算工具时,这些模型可以将高级指令转化为可执行程序,并引用可用的软件功能[18]. 在代理环境下,这些能力可以支持动态任务分解,执行中间操作,以及反复评价和完善其产出[41]. 因此,这些系统不仅可以作为预先确定的产出的预测器,而且可作为目标导向的计算剂,能够根据任务执行期间获得的观察结果选择、组合和修订可执行的行动[45]。 这些新兴能力创造了以灵活、以证据为动力的工作流程取代刚性、有目的的重建管道部分的可能性,在执行过程中动态地确定将各种观察转化为结构化的三维表示所需的程序。

blocks.en: Recent studies have begun to explore large language and multimodal foundation models for building-model generation and editing, BIM interaction, and Scan-to-BIM automation. For example, agentic frameworks have been used to transform natural-language descriptions into editable BIM models [ 8 ] , dynamically query and modify IFC models through tool-augmented reasoning [ 11 ] , and combine point-cloud instance segmentation with large-language-model knowledge for automated Scan-to-BIM generation [ 20 ] . However, the extent to which a general-purpose multimodal foundation model can operate directly as a geometric reconstruction agent remains insufficiently understood. It remains unclear whether a general-purpose multimodal model can autonomously reconstruct building-scale LOD3 models from calibrated multi-view images, camera geometry, and sparse three-dimensional observations. In particular, it is unknown whether this can be achieved zero-shot, without task-specific training or fine-tuning, and without a fixed, purpose-built reconstruction algorithm. Moreover, the influence of the reconstruction-specification guidance provided to the agent, the availability of different input modalities, and the configuration of the underlying foundation model on reconstruction performance has not been systematically characterized. Establishing these capabilities and limitations is necessary to determine whether agentic foundation models can provide a viable and generalizable alternative paradigm for automated building reconstruction rather than serving only as tools for isolated modeling demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究已经开始探索大型语言和多式联运基础模型,用于建筑模型生成和编辑,BIM交互,以及Scan-to-BIM自动化. 例如,代理框架被用于将自然语言描述转化为可编辑的BIM模型[8],通过工具强化推理[11]进行动态查询和修改IFC模型,并将点-云实例分解与大语言模型知识相结合,用于自动化的Scan-to-BIM生成[20]. 然而,一般用途的多式联运基础模型作为几何重建剂可以直接运作的程度仍然不够了解。 通用多式联运模型是否能够从校准的多视图图像、相机几何和稀少的三维观测中自主重建建筑物规模的LOD3模型,这一点仍然不清楚。 特别是,这能否实现零射,没有特定任务训练或微调,也没有固定的,目的建造的重建算法,这一点是未知的. 此外,向代理人提供的重建专项指导的影响、不同投入模式的可得性以及重建业绩基础模型的配置,都没有系统地加以说明。 建立这些能力和限制对于确定代理基础模型是否能够为自动化建筑重建提供一个可行和通用的替代范式,而不是仅仅作为孤立的示范模型的工具是必要的。

blocks.en: To investigate this paradigm, this study introduces AstraLOD3, a zero-shot multimodal agentic framework for generating lightweight and semantically structured LOD3 building models. AstraLOD3 uses Astra GPT [ 29 ] , a general-purpose multimodal foundation model, without task-specific training or fine-tuning. Its inputs comprise multi-view images and their associated Structure-from-Motion outputs, including camera calibration parameters, camera poses, and a filtered sparse point cloud, together with a reconstruction specification defining the required model characteristics, constraints, and outputs. From this information, the agent dynamically plans and executes the reconstruction process by generating computational procedures, selecting and using available Python libraries and Blender tools, interpreting the available visual and geometric evidence, and iteratively evaluating and refining the generated geometry. The resulting models consist of geometrically simplified but architecturally meaningful components organized within a semantic object hierarchy and are accompanied by reproducible procedural code and structured reconstruction metadata. Rather than evaluating the approach through isolated demonstrations, AstraLOD3 is systematically investigated across 24 building reconstruction cases, including a controlled synthetic case, together with complementary experiments examining the effects of reconstruction-specification guidance, available input modalities, Astra model configuration, and run-to-run variability. Its reconstruction performance is additionally evaluated using geometric and image-based metrics and compared with previously published purpose-built approaches for automated LOD model generation. Together, these experiments are designed to assess the accuracy, robustness, autonomy, and practical limitations of general-purpose multimodal foundation models as an alternative paradigm for structured building reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 为了研究这一范式,本研究引入了AstraLOD3,一个零镜头的多式联运代理框架,用于生成轻量级和精密结构的LOD3建筑模型. AstraLOD3使用Astra GPT[29],是一种通用的多式联运基础模型,没有针对特定任务的培训或微调. 其投入包括多视图图像及其相关的结构自动输出,包括相机校准参数、相机外观和过滤的稀释点云,以及界定所需模型特性、限制和输出的重建规格。 从这些信息中,代理人通过生成计算程序,选择和使用现有的Python库和Blender工具,解释现有的视觉和几何证据,以及迭代地评价和精炼生成的几何来动态地规划和实施重建过程. 由此产生的模型由几何简化但具有建筑意义的组件组成,在一个语义对象等级结构中组织,并伴有可复制的程序代码和结构化的重建元数据. AstraLOD3不是通过孤立的示范来评价这一方法,而是对24个建筑重建案例进行系统调查,包括一个受控制的合成案例,同时进行补充实验,审查重建具体化指导、现有投入模式、Astra模型配置和运行到运行的变异性的影响。 此外,还利用几何和基于图像的计量标准对其重建绩效进行了评价,并与以前公布的用于自动LOD模型生成的专用方法进行了比较。 这些实验共同旨在评估通用多式联运基础模型作为结构化建筑重建的替代范式的准确性、稳健性、自主性和实际局限性。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this study are fourfold. First, it introduces AstraLOD3, a zero-shot multimodal agentic framework that uses the general-purpose Astra GPT foundation model to autonomously transform multi-view imagery and associated SfM information into lightweight LOD3 building models without task-specific training or fine-tuning. Beyond geometric reconstruction, the framework produces architecturally meaningful components organized within a semantic object hierarchy. It also records the evidence supporting reconstructed elements and whether their geometry is observed or inferred, while generating reproducible procedural code and structured reconstruction metadata. Second, the study systematically characterizes the behavior of the agentic reconstruction paradigm. Controlled experiments examine the effect of the guidance encoded in the reconstruction specification, the availability of different input modalities, the Astra model configuration, and independent repeated execution. Third, the framework is evaluated across 24 building reconstruction cases, including a controlled synthetic case. Complementary geometric and image-based metrics, together with comparisons against previously published purpose-built LOD reconstruction approaches, provide quantitative evidence of its capabilities and limitations. Fourth, the study contributes an open input–output benchmark comprising the reconstruction inputs, prompting protocols, generated LOD3 models, reconstruction outputs, and evaluation results. This provides a reproducible reference for future research on multimodal foundation models and agentic 3D reconstruction for the built environment.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要贡献有四倍。 首先,它引入了AstraLOD3,一种零镜头的多式联运代理框架,使用通用的Astra GPT基础模型将多视图图像和相关的SfM信息自主转换为轻量级LOD3建筑模型,而无需进行特定任务培训或微调. 除了几何重建外,框架还产生了在语义物体等级结构中组织起来的具有建筑意义的组件. 它还记录了支持重建元素的证据以及其几何学是否被观察到或推断,同时生成可复制的程序代码和结构化重建元数据. 其次,该研究系统地定性了代理重建范式的行为. 受控实验考察了重建规格中编码的制导效果,不同输入方式的可用性,Astra模型配置,以及独立的重复执行. 第三,对24个建筑重建案例,包括一个受控制的合成案例,对该框架进行评价。 补充的几何和基于图像的衡量标准,加上与以前公布的用于目的的LOD重建方法的比较,提供了其能力和局限性的定量证据。 第四,这项研究提供了一个开放的投入-产出基准,包括重建投入、促进协议、生成LOD3模型、重建产出和评价结果。 这为今后研究多式联运基础模型和建筑环境的代理式立体重建提供了可复制的参考。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 2 背景和问题的提出

blocks.en: This section establishes the methodological context and formal reconstruction problem addressed by AstraLOD3. It first summarizes conventional geometry-driven and learning-based approaches for generating structured building models, followed by recent developments in foundation-model-based and agentic 3D model generation. Based on this background, the final subsection formulates the reconstruction problem considered in this study and positions AstraLOD3 with respect to these existing approaches.
blocks.zh: 本节规定了AstraLOD3处理的方法背景和正式重建问题。 报告首先总结了传统的几何驱动和以学习为基础的生成结构化建筑模型的方法,然后总结了基于基础模型和代理三维模型生成的最新发展。 基于这一背景,最后小节阐述了本研究报告中考虑的重建问题和关于这些现有办法的立场。

blocks.en: 2.1 Automated reconstruction of structured building models
blocks.zh: 2.1 结构建筑模型的自动化重建

blocks.en: The generation of structured digital models of existing buildings has traditionally relied on manual or semi-automated interpretation of survey data within CAD environments [ 42 , 9 ] . The increasing availability of laser scanning, photogrammetry, and computer-vision techniques has progressively supported the transition toward scan-to-model and related automated reconstruction workflows. In these workflows, geometric and visual observations are processed to recover explicit building geometry, architectural components, and semantic information [ 43 , 16 ] . Although manual and semi-automated modeling remain important when detailed interpretation or intervention is required, current research increasingly seeks to reduce this effort by automating object recognition, geometric reconstruction, regularization, and semantic organization from point clouds and images [ 5 , 25 ] . These developments have led to a broad range of purpose-built reconstruction methods that combine geometric processing, optimization, domain knowledge, and, increasingly, learned visual or geometric information.
blocks.zh: 现有建筑结构化数字模型的生成传统上依赖于CAD环境中对调查数据的人工或半自动解释[42,9]. 激光扫描、摄影测量和计算机视觉技术的日益普及,逐步支持了向扫描到模型和相关自动化重建工作流程的过渡。 在这些工作流程中,对几何和视觉观测进行了处理,以回收清晰的建筑几何,建筑构件,以及语义信息[43,16]. 虽然在需要详细解释或干预时,手工和半自动化的模型制作仍然很重要,但目前的研究越来越试图通过将物体识别自动化、几何重建、规范化和语义组织从点云和图像[5,25]来减少这种努力。 这些发展导致了一系列的有目的的重建方法,这些方法结合了几何处理,优化,域知识,以及越来越多的学到的视觉或几何信息.

blocks.en: Within this broader landscape, a major family of automated reconstruction methods relies on explicitly defined geometric primitives, constraints, and optimization procedures to transform point clouds into compact building representations. Planar segments can be extracted from the observations, intersected to generate candidate surfaces, and jointly selected through optimization to obtain regularized polygonal models, as exemplified by the PolyFit formulation [ 27 ] . Related approaches fit parameterized building components directly to measured point clouds or combine geometric extraction with domain-specific constraints to recover structured models [ 38 ] . Such methods commonly rely on assumptions such as planarity, verticality, parallelism or orthogonality, together with thresholds and objective-function weights controlling primitive extraction, data fidelity, model complexity, and point support. For example, a previous LOD3 reconstruction approach combined Structure-from-Motion, point-cloud filtering, planar primitive extraction, and PolyFit-based optimization to generate lightweight LOD2 building envelopes that were subsequently enriched to LOD3 using image-derived information [ 32 ] . These approaches provide strong geometric control and compact outputs, but their reconstruction procedures, geometric assumptions, and parameter settings are generally specified in advance for the intended reconstruction task.
blocks.zh: 在这个更广泛的地貌中,一套主要的自动化重建方法依赖于明确定义的几何原始物,制约,以及优化程序,将点云转化为紧凑的建筑代表物. 平板块可以从观测中提取,交叉生成候选表面,并通过优化联合选择,以获得正规化的多边形模型,例如PolyFit配方[27]. 相关方法将参数化的建筑组件直接匹配到测量的点云或结合几何提取和特定域的制约以回收结构模型[38]. 这类方法通常依赖于诸如计划性、垂直性、平行性或正交性等假设,以及控制原始提取、数据忠实性、模型复杂性和点支持的阈值和客观功能权重。 例如,之前的LOD3重建方法结合了结构-从动,点-云过滤,平面原始提取,以及基于PolyFit的优化,生成轻量级LOD2建筑信封,然后利用图像生成的信息被浓缩为LOD3[32]. 这些方法提供了强大的几何控制和紧凑的产出,但其重建程序、几何假设和参数设置一般是事先为预定的重建任务规定的。

blocks.en: Learning-based methods have increasingly been incorporated into building reconstruction to automate the recognition and interpretation of geometric and semantic information from images and point clouds. In many cases, learned perception is integrated within hybrid workflows that retain explicit geometric processing and domain knowledge. For example, Scan2LoD3 combines multimodal observations, building priors, ray-based geometric reasoning, and probabilistic inference to reconstruct semantic LOD3 building models [ 46 ] . Other approaches have extended learning toward larger parts of the reconstruction process. Deep-learning-based point-cloud segmentation has been combined with parametric reconstruction for automated BIM generation [ 24 ] . Learned hierarchical segmentation and skeleton-graph prediction have also been used to reconstruct semantically organized LOD3 parametric models [ 50 ] . Learned visual information can also be transferred to reconstructed geometry through calibrated image-to-3D mapping; this strategy has been used to associate architectural openings with building envelopes and was subsequently extended to map damage information into damage-augmented digital twins [ 31 ] . These methods demonstrate the increasing capability of learned models to automate perception and parts of geometric reconstruction. However, their processing architecture, target semantic classes, and interaction between learned and geometric components are generally defined in advance. Their performance and accessible classes also remain influenced by the availability and representativeness of task-specific training data.
blocks.zh: 以学习为基础的方法越来越多地被纳入建筑重建,使从图像和点云对几何和语义信息的识别和解释自动化。 在许多情况下,学到的认知被融合到混合工作流程中,这些工作流程保留了明确的几何处理和域知识. 例如,Scan2LOD3结合了多式联运观测,建筑前身,射线几何推理,概率推论重建语义LOD3建筑模型[46]. 其他方法将学习推广到重建进程的更大部分。 深入学习的点云分解与参数重建相结合,用于自动化BIM生成[24]. 所学的分级和骨架图预测也被用来重建精密排列的LOD3参数模型[50]. 所学的视觉信息也可以通过校准图像到3D的映射转移到重建几何;这一策略被用于将建筑开口与建筑信封联系起来,随后被扩展为将损坏信息映射到损坏加固的数码双胞胎[31]. 这些方法表明,学习的模型越来越有能力使几何重建的认知和部分功能自动化。 然而,它们的处理架构,目标语义类,以及所学和几何元件之间的相互作用一般是事先定义的. 其业绩和无障碍课程也仍然受到具体任务培训数据的提供和代表性的影响。

blocks.en: Overall, purpose-built reconstruction methods have progressively enabled the generation of increasingly detailed and information-rich building representations by combining geometric processing, optimization, learned perception, and domain-specific knowledge. This progression has extended beyond exterior LOD3 models toward representations that integrate additional semantic information and interior geometry. For example, LOD4 building models have been generated by separately processing exterior and interior SfM reconstructions using planar primitives and subsequently registering them through image-based correspondences [ 33 ] . Such developments demonstrate that specialized reconstruction pipelines can provide robust and geometrically controlled solutions for complex modeling tasks. At the same time, across both geometry-driven and learning-based approaches, the sequence of processing operations, geometric assumptions, target semantic information, and interaction between individual algorithms are largely established during method development. This motivates the investigation of more flexible reconstruction strategies in which part of the computational procedure can instead be formulated dynamically according to the available observations and the required modeling objective.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,专门设计的重建方法通过结合几何处理、优化、学习感知和特定领域知识,逐渐使建筑物的表述内容更加详细,信息更加丰富。 这一进展已经超越了LOD3外表模型,而转向将额外的语义信息和内部几何融合在一起的表示. 例如,LOD4的建筑模型是通过使用平面原始物单独处理外立面和内部SfM重建而生成的,随后通过基于图像的函证进行注册[33]. 这些事态发展表明,专门的重建管道可以为复杂的建模任务提供有力和几何控制的解决办法。 同时,通过几何驱动和基于学习的方法,处理操作的顺序,几何假设,目标语义信息,以及个体算法之间的相互作用,在方法开发过程中基本建立. 这推动了对更灵活的重建战略的调查,在这种战略中,可以根据现有观察和所需的建模目标,动态地制定部分计算程序。

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation models and agentic 3D generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 基础模型和代理三维生成

blocks.en: General-purpose foundation models extend conventional task-specific learning by providing broad pretrained capabilities that can be adapted to new downstream problems without training a separate model for each fixed input–output mapping. More importantly for complex computational tasks, their role can extend beyond generating textual or visual responses when they are coupled with external tools and executable actions. Approaches such as ReAct and Toolformer demonstrated that language models can dynamically select actions or external tools, incorporate the resulting information, and continue the task according to its evolving state [ 48 , 39 ] . This capability has subsequently been extended to multimodal settings, where models can combine visual and textual information with specialized tools for perception, generation, and information retrieval [ 21 ] . In this setting, heterogeneous information such as images, code, structured files, and tool-accessible geometric data can be incorporated within a common task-solving process. Agents can then decompose a task into intermediate operations, select and execute computational procedures, inspect their outputs, and iteratively refine the solution toward a specified objective.
blocks.zh: 普通用途基础模型通过提供广泛的预先培训能力,以适应新的下游问题,而无需为每次固定投入-产出绘图培训一个单独的模型,从而扩展常规任务特定学习。 更重要的是,对于复杂的计算任务,当它们与外部工具和可执行的行动相结合时,它们的作用可以超越生成文字或视觉反应. ReAct and Toolformer等方法表明,语言模型可以动态地选择动作或外部工具,纳入由此产生的信息,并根据其不断发展的状态继续执行这项任务[48,39]. 这一能力后来扩大到多式联运环境,模型可以将视觉和文字信息与感知、生成和信息检索的专门工具结合起来[21]。 在此设定中,可以将图像,代码,结构化文件,工具可访问的几何数据等多样信息纳入共同的任务解决过程. 代理人然后可将任务分解成中间操作,选择和执行计算程序,检查其产出,并反复完善解决方案,以达到特定的目标.

blocks.en: Foundation models and generative AI have also been increasingly explored for automatic 3D content generation. Direct generative approaches can synthesize three-dimensional representations from textual or visual inputs, for example by optimizing neural representations from text prompts [ 35 ] or predicting 3D representations directly from single images using large-scale learned reconstruction models [ 13 ] . A complementary research direction represents 3D generation as a programmatic task, allowing language or multimodal models to interact with established modeling environments through executable code. SceneCraft, for example, converts textual scene descriptions into Blender Python programs and uses rendered visual feedback to iteratively refine the generated scene [ 14 ] , while MeshCoder learns to transform point clouds into structured and editable Blender Python scripts [ 6 ] . Compared with directly generated neural or mesh representations, programmatic generation provides an explicit and editable description of the modeling operations and enables generated geometry to be regenerated, inspected, and subsequently modified through the corresponding executable procedure.
blocks.zh: 基础模型和基因AI也越来越多地为自动3D内容生成而探索. 直接的基因表达法可以合成文字或视觉输入的三维表达法,例如通过优化文字提示的神经表达法[35]或利用大规模学习的重建模型直接从单个图像中预测3D表达法[13]. 一个互补的研究方向将3D生成作为一种方案任务,使语言或多式联运模式能够通过可执行代码与既定的建模环境相互作用。 例如SceneCraft将文字场景描述转换为Blender Python程序,并使用使视觉反馈能够迭代地精炼生成的场景[14],而MeshCoder学习将点云转换为结构化和可编辑的Blender Python脚本[6]. 与直接生成的神经元或网格表示相比,程序生成提供了对模型操作的清晰和可编辑的描述,并使得生成的几何图形能够通过相应的可执行程序重新生成,检查,然后修改.

blocks.en: Agentic foundation-model approaches have recently begun to appear in building modeling and reconstruction. BIMgent uses multimodal large language models as computer-use agents within BIM software [ 7 ] . The agents plan and execute modeling operations through the graphical interface, demonstrating the potential of foundation models for automating extended building-modeling tasks. More directly related to reconstruction, an LLM-enabled multi-agent framework has been proposed for zero-shot Scan-to-BIM and Scan-to-Graph generation from point clouds, integrating query interpretation, geometric inference, topology-aware IFC generation, semantic graph construction, and multi-stage validation [ 30 ] . A particularly close development is SVI2LOD3 [ 17 ] , which employs an agent-driven workflow combining large language and visual models with expert-designed programs to reconstruct façade openings from volunteered street-view imagery. The method uses zero-shot visual segmentation and geometric projection to enrich existing LOD2 CityGML buildings with windows and doors while preserving semantic and partonomic relationships in the resulting LOD3 representation. This formulation is closely related to the objectives considered here because it combines foundation models, tool-based execution, zero-shot perception, and semantic LOD3 generation; however, its reconstruction task starts from an existing LOD2 building model and primarily focuses on façade-opening enrichment. In contrast, the problem addressed by AstraLOD3 considers the generation of the complete lightweight building model directly from multi-view imagery and SfM-derived camera and sparse geometric information, including the reconstruction of the building envelope, roof configuration, architectural components, and their semantic organization.
blocks.zh: 最近,在建模和重建方面开始出现代理性的基础模式办法。 BIMgent在BIM软件内部使用多式大型语言模型作为计算机使用代理[7]. 代理商通过图形界面计划并执行建模操作,展示基础模型实现扩展的建模任务自动化的潜力. 更直接地与重建相关,提出了LLM驱动的多剂框架,用于从点云产生零镜头Scan-to-BIM和Scan-to-Graph,整合查询解释,几何推论,地貌认识的IFC生成,语义图构建,以及多阶段验证[30]. SVI2LOD3[17]是一个特别密切的发展,它采用了由代理驱动的工作流程,将大型语言和视觉模型与专家设计的程序结合起来,从自愿的街景图像中重建外观开口。 这种方法采用零镜头视觉分解和几何投影法,用窗和门丰富现有的LOD2 CityGML建筑,同时在由此产生的LOD3代表物中保持语义关系和编组关系. 这种提法与这里考虑的目标密切相关,因为它结合了基础模型,基于工具的执行,零射感知,以及语义LOD3生成;然而,它的重建任务从现有的LOD2建筑模型开始,主要侧重于表面打开的浓缩. 相比之下,AstraLOD3所处理的问题考虑的是直接从多视图图像和SfM衍生的相机和稀疏几何信息中生成完整的轻量级建筑模型,包括重建建筑信封,屋顶配置,建筑构件,以及它们的语义组织.

blocks.en: 2.3 Problem formulation and positioning of AstraLOD3
blocks.zh: 2.3 AstraLOD3的配方和定位问题

blocks.en: The reconstruction problem considered in this work is formulated as the transformation of a multimodal evidence set ℐ \mathcal{I} and a reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} into a lightweight, semantically structured LOD3 building model ℳ \mathcal{M} . The available evidence is defined as ℐ = { 𝒱 , 𝒞 , 𝒫 } , \mathcal{I}=\{\mathcal{V},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{P}\}, where 𝒱 \mathcal{V} denotes the available multi-view images, 𝒞 \mathcal{C} contains the calibrated camera intrinsics and poses associated with the registered images, and 𝒫 \mathcal{P} is the filtered sparse SfM point cloud. The reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} defines the modeling objective, evidence rules, geometric and semantic constraints, execution limits, required outputs, and the level of reconstruction guidance provided to the agent. The target representation is expressed as ℳ = { 𝒢 , 𝒮 , ℋ , ℰ } , \mathcal{M}=\{\mathcal{G},\mathcal{S},\mathcal{H},\mathcal{E}\}, where 𝒢 \mathcal{G} represents the lightweight building geometry, 𝒮 \mathcal{S} the semantic architectural components, ℋ \mathcal{H} their hierarchical relationships, and ℰ \mathcal{E} the supporting evidence and provenance associated with each component, including whether its geometry is directly observed or inferred. The reconstruction objective can therefore be expressed as F : ( ℐ , ℛ ) → ℳ , F:(\mathcal{I},\mathcal{R})\rightarrow\mathcal{M}, subject to consistency with the available geometric and image observations, preservation of architecturally relevant components, and compact geometric representation.
blocks.zh: 本作品中考虑的重建问题,是将多式联运证据集 I\ mathcal{I} 和重建规格 R\ mathcal{R} 转化为轻量级,精密结构的 LOD3 建筑模型 M\ mathcal{M} 。 现有证据的定义为I={V,C,P},\mathcal{I}=\{\Mathcal{V},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{P},其中V\mathcal{V}表示现有的多视图图像,C\mathcal{C}包含与注册图像相关的校准相机内在和姿势,P\mathcal{P}是过滤的稀疏的SfM点云. 重建规格R\mathcal{R}定义了建模目标,证据规则,几何和语义限制,执行限制,所需输出,以及向代理提供的重建指导水平. 目标表达方式为 M = { G, S, H, E },\ mathcal{ M}=\{\mathcal{ G},\ mathcal{H},\mathcal{H},\mathcal{E},其中 G\mathcal{G 代表轻量级建筑几何, S\mathcal{S} 语义建筑组件, H\mathcal{H} 其等级关系,和 E\mathcal{E } 与每个组件相关的佐证证据和出处,包括其几何是否直接观测或推断. 因此,重建目标可以表述为F : (I, R) – M : (\mathcal{I},\mathcal{R})\rightarrow\mathcal{M},但须符合现有的几何和图像观测,保存与建筑相关的组件,以及紧凑的几何表示.

blocks.en: In AstraLOD3, the mapping F F is not implemented as a fixed reconstruction algorithm or a task-specific trained network. Instead, the framework operates under bounded autonomy. The reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} defines the objective, evidence rules, geometric and semantic requirements, execution constraints, procedural guidance, and required outputs. Within these boundaries, the agent determines how the requirements are computationally realized. It can inspect the available observations, decompose the reconstruction task into intermediate operations, and generate and execute code. It can also select computational libraries and Blender operations, construct geometric hypotheses, and evaluate intermediate results against the supplied evidence. The reconstruction procedure is therefore instantiated dynamically during execution rather than being completely encoded in advance by the method developer. Importantly, this autonomy remains constrained by the reconstruction specification. Architectural components must be supported by the supplied visual or geometric evidence, and the generated model must remain in the SfM coordinate system. The specified output requirements must also be satisfied, while validation and geometric refinement remain subject to predefined limits. Consequently, AstraLOD3 shifts part of the reconstruction logic from explicit algorithm design before execution to agent-directed selection and composition of computational procedures during execution, while retaining externally defined objectives and constraints.
blocks.zh: 在AstraLOD3中,映射F F不是作为固定重建算法或任务特定训练网络来执行的. 相反,该框架在有限度的自治下运作。 重建规格 R\ mathcal{R} 定义了目标, 证据规则, 几何和语义要求, 执行限制, 程序指导, 以及所需的输出 。 在这些界限内,代理人决定如何计算各项要求。 它可以检查现有的观测结果,将重建任务分解为中间操作,并生成和执行代码. 它还可以选择计算库和Blender操作,构建几何假说,并根据所提供的证据评价中间结果. 因此,重建程序在执行期间被即时动态化,而不是由方法开发者事先完全编码. 重要的是,这种自主权仍然受到重建规定的限制。 建筑构件必须得到所提供的视觉或几何证据的支持,生成的模型必须留在SfM坐标系统中. 规定的输出要求也必须得到满足,同时验证和几何精度的改进仍受预先确定的限度限制. 因此,AstraLOD3将重建逻辑的一部分从执行前的明确算法设计转移到执行期间由代理人指导的计算程序选择和组成,同时保留外部确定的目标和限制。

blocks.en: Within this context, AstraLOD3 investigates whether a general-purpose multimodal foundation model can dynamically organize and execute building-scale LOD3 reconstruction from calibrated multi-view evidence without task-specific training or fine-tuning. In contrast to purpose-built reconstruction pipelines, the framework does not prescribe a complete sequence of reconstruction algorithms or rely on a dedicated learned model trained to map the available observations directly to the desired building representation. Instead, the general-purpose agent is provided with the reconstruction evidence ℐ \mathcal{I} and specification ℛ \mathcal{R} , and is responsible for selecting, generating, and coordinating the computational procedures required to recover the building envelope, roof configuration, openings, and other architecturally relevant components while satisfying the defined geometric and semantic constraints. The term zero-shot is therefore used here at the reconstruction-task level: no task-specific training or fine-tuning, building-specific pretrained reconstruction pipeline, externally supplied 3D assets, or access to ground-truth geometry is used during reconstruction. It does not imply that the underlying general-purpose foundation model is itself untrained; rather, the study evaluates whether its broad pretrained multimodal and tool-use capabilities can be transferred directly to a previously unseen building-reconstruction task. Accordingly, AstraLOD3 is not positioned as a replacement for a specific geometric or learning-based reconstruction algorithm. Instead, it provides an alternative computational formulation in which heterogeneous reconstruction operations are selected and combined dynamically under bounded autonomy. These operations ultimately produce a lightweight and semantically structured LOD3 representation.
blocks.zh: 在这方面, AstraLOD3调查通用的多式联运基础模型是否能够在不进行特定任务培训或微调的情况下,从校准的多视图证据中动态地组织并执行建筑规模的LOD3重建. 与目的建造的重建管道不同,框架没有规定完整的重建算法序列,也没有依赖经过培训的专门学习模型,将现有观测结果直接映射到理想的建筑物代表. 相反,向通用代理商提供了I\mathcal{I}和规格R\mathcal{R}的重建证据,并负责选择、生成和协调回收建筑物信封、屋顶配置、开口和其他建筑相关部件所需的计算程序,同时满足确定的几何和语义限制。 因此,这里在重建任务一级使用零射线一词:在重建期间,没有使用特定任务的培训或微调、特定建筑物的预先训练重建管道、外部提供的3D资产,也没有使用地面真实几何技术。 这并不意味着基本的普通用途基础模型本身没有经过培训;相反,该研究评价其广泛的预先培训的多式联运和工具使用能力是否可以直接转移到以前未见的建筑重建任务。 因此,AstraLOD3没有定位为特定几何或基于学习的重建算法的替代. 相反,它提供了一个备选的计算公式,其中选择不同的重建行动,并在有限度的自主权下进行动态合并。 这些行动最终产生了轻量级和精密结构的LOD3代表.

blocks.en: 3 AstraLOD3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 AstraLOD3 数据 方法

blocks.en: Building on the problem formulation introduced in Section 2 , AstraLOD3 provides a computational framework for transforming multimodal reconstruction evidence ℐ \mathcal{I} and a human-defined reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} into a lightweight and semantically structured LOD3 representation ℳ \mathcal{M} . The framework uses GPT-6 Astra [ 29 ] (hereafter Astra), a general-purpose multimodal foundation model, through the Codex IDE extension in Visual Studio Code. Codex provides the agentic interface through which the model can access the reconstruction workspace, inspect and modify files, generate and execute code, and interact with external computational tools.
blocks.zh: AstraLOD3以第2节中引入的问题表述为基础,为将多式联运重建证据I\mathcal{I}和人定义的重建规格R\mathcal{R}转换为轻量级和精密结构的LOD3代表M\mathcal{M}提供了计算框架. 该框架通过Visual Studio代码中的Codex IDE扩展使用GPT-6 Astra [29](以下简称Astra),是一种通用的多式联运基础模型. Codex提供了代理界面,模型可以通过它访问重建工作空间,检查和修改文件,生成和执行代码,并与外部计算工具互动.

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the overall framework. Two complementary human-defined inputs specify the reconstruction problem. The reconstruction evidence ℐ \mathcal{I} is made available to the agent within the reconstruction workspace and comprises multi-view images 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , calibrated camera information 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , and a filtered sparse SfM point cloud 𝒫 \mathcal{P} . The reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} is communicated as a natural-language task prompt defining the reconstruction objective and the boundaries within which the agent operates, including the admissible evidence, geometric and semantic requirements, representation constraints, procedural guidance, execution restrictions, and required outputs. Together, ℐ \mathcal{I} and ℛ \mathcal{R} define the reconstruction problem without completely prescribing the computational procedure used to solve it.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了总体框架。 两项由人为界定的补充投入具体指明了重建问题。 重建证据 I\ mathcal{I} 提供给重建工作区内的代理商, 包括多视图图像 V\ mathcal{V}, 校准的相机信息 C\ mathcal{C}, 以及过滤的稀疏 SfM 点云 P\ mathcal{P} 。 R \ mathcal{R} 重建规格作为自然语言的任务来传达, 以迅速确定重建目标和代理业务的界限, 包括可接受的证据、 几何和语义要求、 代表限制、 程序指导、 执行限制和所需产出。 I\ mathcal{I} 和 R\ mathcal{R} 一起定义重建问题, 而不完全指定用于解决问题的计算程序 。

blocks.en: Operating through Codex, the Astra agent works under bounded autonomy and interacts with an external computational environment providing access to Python execution, numerical and image-processing libraries, filesystem operations, and Blender [ 3 ] for programmatic 3D modeling. During execution, the agent may inspect and transform the available data, formulate intermediate geometric interpretations, generate task-specific scripts, construct and modify geometry, inspect intermediate results, and select additional computational operations according to the evolving state of the reconstruction. Consequently, the exact sequence of operations is not represented as a fixed algorithmic pipeline; instead, the computational trajectory is determined dynamically within the constraints defined by ℛ \mathcal{R} . AstraLOD3 therefore separates the reconstruction elements specified before execution from the computational procedures determined dynamically for each building and set of observations.
blocks.zh: 通过 Codex 操作,Astra 代理在受约束的自主性下工作,并与外部的计算环境相互作用,提供访问 Python 执行,数字和图像处理库,文件系统操作,以及Blender [3] 的程序3D模型. 执行期间,代理商可以检查和转换现有数据,制定中间几何解释,生成特定任务的脚本,构造和修改几何,检查中间结果,并根据重建的演变状态选择额外的计算操作. 因此,精确的操作序列不作为固定的算法管道来表示;相反,计算轨迹是在R\mathcal{R}定义的限制范围内动态确定的. 因此,AstraLOD3将执行前指定的重建要素与按动态方式确定的每栋建筑的计算程序和一组观测数据分开。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the AstraLOD3 framework. The reconstruction problem is defined before execution through the multimodal evidence ℐ \mathcal{I} and reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} . The evidence is provided as files within the reconstruction workspace, whereas ℛ \mathcal{R} is communicated to Astra GPT as a natural-language task prompt. Operating through Codex in Visual Studio Code and under bounded autonomy, the agent interacts with the available computational environment to inspect the evidence, execute computational operations, and generate the building model. The reconstruction trajectory is determined dynamically within the specified constraints, producing the structured LOD3 representation ℳ \mathcal{M} , the required outputs, and execution-dependent supporting files.
blocks.zh: 图1:AstraLOD3框架概览。 重建问题通过多模式证据 I\ mathcal{I} 和重建规格 R\ mathcal{R} 执行前定义 。 证据作为重建工作空间内的文件提供,而R\ mathcal{R}作为自然语言任务即时传递给Astra GPT. 通过Visual Studio代码中的 Codex 操作,并在限定的自主性下,代理与可用的计算环境进行交互,以检查证据,执行计算操作,并生成建筑模型. 重建轨迹在指定限度内动态确定,生成结构化的LOD3代表M\mathcal{M},所需的输出,以及依赖执行的辅助文件.

blocks.en: 3.1 Multimodal reconstruction evidence
blocks.zh: 3.1 多式联运重建证据

blocks.en: The reconstruction evidence is defined as ℐ = { 𝒱 , 𝒞 , 𝒫 } , \mathcal{I}=\{\mathcal{V},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{P}\}, (1) where 𝒱 \mathcal{V} denotes the set of multi-view images, 𝒞 \mathcal{C} the calibrated camera information associated with the images registered by SfM, and 𝒫 \mathcal{P} a filtered sparse SfM point cloud of the target building. The camera information and sparse three-dimensional geometry are obtained before agent execution by processing the image set with COLMAP-based SfM [ 40 ] . The SfM reconstruction estimates camera intrinsics and poses for the registered images together with a sparse set of triangulated 3D points. The images, calibrated camera information, and subsequently filtered sparse point cloud are stored in the reconstruction workspace and made accessible to the Astra agent through Codex.
blocks.zh: 重建证据的定义是: I = {V,C,P},\ mathcal{V},\mathcal{V},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{P},(1) 其中V\mathcal{V}表示多视图图像集,C\mathcal{C}与SfM注册的图像相关的校准相机信息,以及P\mathcal{P}目标建筑的过滤稀疏的SfM点云. 相机信息和稀疏的三维几何在代理执行前通过处理基于COLMAP的SfM的图像集[40]. SfM重建估计了已注册图像的内在和外观以及一组稀少的三角立体点. 图像,校准的相机信息,以及后来过滤的稀释点云,都存储在重建工作空间中,并通过Codex让Astra代理机访问.

blocks.en: More specifically, the visual evidence is represented as 𝒱 = { I i } i = 1 N , \mathcal{V}=\{I_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N}, (2) where I i I_{i} denotes the i i th input image. Let 𝒥 ⊆ { 1 , … , N } \mathcal{J}\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\} denote the subset of images registered by the SfM reconstruction. The associated calibrated camera information is expressed as 𝒞 = { K i , R i , t i } i ∈ 𝒥 , \mathcal{C}=\{K_{i},R_{i},t_{i}\}_{i\in\mathcal{J}}, (3) where K i K_{i} contains the camera intrinsics and ( R i , t i ) (R_{i},t_{i}) denotes the corresponding world-to-camera extrinsic transformation recovered by SfM. The sparse point-cloud evidence is represented as 𝒫 = { ( 𝐩 j , 𝐜 j ) } j = 1 M , \mathcal{P}=\{(\mathbf{p}_{j},\mathbf{c}_{j})\}_{j=1}^{M}, (4) where 𝐩 j ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{p}_{j}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} is the position of the j j th retained sparse SfM point and 𝐜 j \mathbf{c}_{j} denotes its associated RGB color.

Before being placed in the reconstruction workspace, the original sparse SfM point cloud is filtered to reduce points associated with dispersed outliers and regions outside the dominant building extent. The filtering consists of statistical outlier removal based on the mean distance from each point to its k k nearest neighbours, using a threshold of the form μ d + α ​ σ d \mu_{d}+\alpha\sigma_{d} , followed by robust cropping within a percentile-based bounding box aligned with the principal directions of the point cloud using principal component analysis. The resulting point set constitutes 𝒫 \mathcal{P} .

blocks.en: The three modalities provide complementary information for reconstruction. The image set 𝒱 \mathcal{V} supplies visual evidence regarding architectural configuration and component appearance, including façade organization, openings, roof form, projections, and other visible elements. The calibrated camera information 𝒞 \mathcal{C} establishes the projective relationship between registered image observations and the three-dimensional SfM reference frame. It allows observations from different views to be related geometrically and enables the generated model to be projected into the corresponding images. The sparse point cloud 𝒫 \mathcal{P} provides explicit three-dimensional geometric support for sufficiently reconstructed parts of the building, particularly major surfaces and the overall envelope, together with the color information associated with the retained SfM points.
blocks.zh: 三种模式为重建提供了补充信息。 图像集 V\ mathcal{V} 提供了建筑配置和组件外观的视觉证据, 包括外观组织、 开口、 屋顶形式、 预测等可见元素。 校准的相机信息C\mathcal{C}确立了已注册图像观测与三维SfM参考框架之间的投影关系. 它可以使来自不同观点的观测在几何上互相关联,并使生成的模型能够投射到相应的图像中. 稀释点云P\mathcal{P}为建筑物中足够重建的部分提供了明确的三维几何支持,特别是主要表面和整体信封,以及与保留SfM点相关的颜色信息.

blocks.en: The camera information and sparse point cloud share the coordinate system established by the SfM reconstruction. The reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} requires AstraLOD3 to treat this SfM frame as the common geometric reference and to keep the generated geometry expressed in the same coordinate system. No independent scaling, rotation, or translation of the reconstructed building is allowed. This preserves the geometric relationship among the images, calibrated cameras, sparse point cloud, and generated model and provides a common reference for subsequent validation and quantitative evaluation.
blocks.zh: 相机信息和稀释点云共享SfM重建建立的坐标系统. 重建规格R\mathcal{R}要求AstraLOD3将这个SfM框架作为通用的几何参考,并保持生成的几何表达在同一坐标系统中. 不允许对重建的建筑物进行独立的缩放、旋转或翻译。 这保存了图像之间的几何关系,校准相机,稀释点云,并生成模型,为后续验证和定量评价提供了共同的参考.

blocks.en: 3.2 Reconstruction specification
blocks.zh: 3.2 重建规格

blocks.en: The reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} is encoded as a natural-language task prompt provided to the Astra agent at the beginning of each reconstruction run. While the reconstruction evidence ℐ \mathcal{I} is made available as files within the reconstruction workspace, ℛ \mathcal{R} defines how this evidence should be used and establishes the requirements and constraints under which the agent operates. It specifies the reconstruction objective, evidence-use rules, geometric and semantic representation requirements, degree of procedural guidance, execution restrictions, and required outputs. These elements are summarized in Table 1 . Rather than prescribing a complete reconstruction algorithm, ℛ \mathcal{R} defines the boundaries of the reconstruction problem while leaving the specific computational procedures used to satisfy them to the agent.
blocks.zh: 重建规格 R\ mathcal{R} 被编码为每次重建运行开始时向 Astra 代理提供的自然语言任务提示 。 虽然重建证据 I\ mathcal{I} 已作为重建工作空间内的文档提供, R\ mathcal{R} 界定了如何使用这些证据, 并确定了代理运行的要求和限制 。 它规定了重建目标、证据使用规则、几何和语义表达要求、程序指导的程度、执行限制和所需产出。 表1概述了这些要素。 R\ mathcal{R} 并没有规定完整的重建算法,而是定义了重建问题的边界,同时将用来满足它们的具体计算程序留给了代理商.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Main elements of the AstraLOD3 reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} .
blocks.zh: 表1: AstraLOD3重建规格R\mathcal{R}的主要内容.

blocks.en: The reconstruction objective is to generate a detail-enriched but lightweight LOD3 representation of the observed building. The specification prioritizes consistency with the supplied SfM geometry and image observations under the calibrated cameras, preservation of architecturally relevant components, and compact geometric representation. Representative components include the main building envelope, façade planes, roof geometry, openings, simplified frames, balconies, parapets, overhangs, chimneys, and other major architectural projections when supported by the available evidence. Elements that do not contribute meaningfully to the architectural representation, such as vegetation, vehicles, people, cables, furniture, individual bricks, or very small decorative details, are excluded.
blocks.zh: 重建目标是为所观察的建筑物提供详细但轻量级的LOD3代表。 规格优先考虑与提供的SfM几何和图像观测在校准相机下的一致性,保存与建筑相关的组件,以及紧凑的几何表示. 具有代表性的组成部分包括主建筑信封、外观平面、屋顶几何、开口、简化框架、瓦房、栏杆、悬架、烟囱等,以及在现有证据支持下的其他主要建筑预测。 植被、车辆、人、电缆、家具、个别砖块或非常小的装饰细节等对建筑代表性没有有意义的贡献的因素,不包括在内。

blocks.en:
A central element of ℛ \mathcal{R} is the evidence rule. Architectural components are not introduced solely because they would normally be expected for a particular building type or architectural style. Each modeled component must instead be supported by at least one supplied image or by the available three-dimensional geometry.
This requirement does not prevent geometric completion where observations are incomplete, provided that inferred geometry is kept geometrically simple and distinguished from directly observed geometry. When part of the geometry is genuinely unobservable but a representation is required to obtain a coherent building model, the agent is instructed to adopt the simplest geometrically reasonable interpretation rather than introducing unsupported architectural detail. The resulting reconstruction metadata records whether major component geometry is directly observed or inferred.
blocks.zh:
R \ mathcal{R} 的中心元素是证据规则 。 建筑构件的引入并非仅仅因为通常期望它们用于某一特定建筑类型或建筑风格. 相反,每个模型组件必须至少有一个提供的图像或可用的三维几何支持。
这一要求并不妨碍在观测不完整的情况下完成几何学,前提是推断的几何学保持几何学简单,并与直接观测到的几何学区分开来. 当部分几何确实不可观察,但需要表示才能获得连贯的建筑模型时,就指示代理人采用最简单的几何合理解释,而不是引入无根据的建筑细节. 由此产生的重建元数据记录了主要元件几何是直接观测还是推断出来的.

blocks.en: The specification also constrains the form of the generated geometry. Low-complexity procedural representations are preferred, including planar surfaces, extrusions, Boolean openings, repeated or instanced elements, and simple profile geometry, while unnecessarily dense meshes are discouraged. The generated model is also required to remain in the SfM reference frame defined by the reconstruction evidence. Together, these requirements promote compact, structured, and editable architectural geometry rather than a dense surface reproduction of the observed scene.
blocks.zh: 规格还制约了生成的几何形态. 比较喜欢低复杂性的程序表述,包括平面、挤压、布尔开口、重复或实例元素以及简单的剖面几何,同时不鼓励不必要地密集的网格。 生成的模型也需要留在重建证据确定的SfM参考框架. 这些要求共同促进紧凑、结构化和可编辑的建筑几何,而不是对所观测的场景进行密集的表面复制。

blocks.en: Procedural guidance forms another component of ℛ \mathcal{R} . The reconstruction specification organizes the task into six high-level stages comprising evidence inspection, reconstruction planning, programmatic geometry generation, validation, iterative refinement, and finalization, with a maximum of three geometry-refinement iterations. These stages prescribe the intermediate objectives of the reconstruction rather than the algorithms or computational operations used to achieve them; their realization is determined by the agent during execution, as described in Section 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 程序引导构成 R\ mathcal{R} 的另一个组件. 重建规格将任务分为6个高级阶段,包括证据检查,重建规划,方案几何生成,验证,迭代完善,最后敲定,最多可进行3个几何修饰迭代. 这些阶段规定了重建的中间目标,而不是用于实现这些目标的算法或计算操作;如第3.3节所述,其实现由执行过程中的代理人决定。

blocks.en: The reconstruction specification also defines the execution restrictions and required outputs for each run. The agent is restricted to the supplied reconstruction data and the software available through the computational environment and is not permitted to access external web resources, building-specific pretrained reconstruction pipelines, external 3D assets, ground-truth or evaluation geometry, or manual user corrections during reconstruction. In addition, ℛ \mathcal{R} requires a common set of model representations, executable reconstruction code, structured semantic and provenance information, and run documentation. The complete reconstruction specification used for the reference experiments is provided in A . The resulting model representation and generated outputs are described in Section 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 重建规格还界定了每次运行的执行限制和所需的产出. 该代理仅限于所提供的重建数据和通过计算环境提供的软件,不允许访问外部网络资源,特定建筑物的预训重建管道,外部3D资产,地面真相或评价几何,或在重建过程中手动校正用户. 此外,R\mathcal{R}需要一套通用的模型表示,可执行重建代码,结构化的语义和来源信息,并运行文档. A节提供了参考实验所用的完整的重建规格。 第3.4节介绍了由此产生的模型表述和产出。

blocks.en: 3.3 Agentic reconstruction process
blocks.zh: 3.3 代理重建进程

blocks.en: The reconstruction specification organizes the AstraLOD3 process into six high-level stages: evidence inspection, reconstruction planning, programmatic geometry generation, validation, iterative refinement, and finalization. These stages define the main objectives to be achieved during reconstruction, but they do not prescribe the algorithms or computational operations used within them. Operating through Codex, the Astra agent determines how each stage is carried out. It inspects the available evidence, generates and executes task-specific code, and uses the computational tools available in the reconstruction workspace. Subsequent operations are adapted according to the intermediate results obtained.
blocks.zh: 重建规格将AstraLOD3进程分为六个高级别阶段:证据检查、重建规划、方案几何生成、验证、迭代完善和定稿。 这些阶段确定了重建期间要实现的主要目标,但它们没有规定其中所使用的算法或计算操作. 通过 Codex 操作, Astra 代理决定每个阶段的进行方式. 它检查现有证据,生成和执行特定任务的代码,并使用重建工作空间中可用的计算工具. 后续业务根据获得的中间结果进行调整。

blocks.en: The agent first inspects the available images, calibrated camera information, and sparse point cloud to establish an initial interpretation of the building. This includes identifying the principal building surfaces, approximate envelope and roof configuration, and visible architectural components relevant to the target LOD3 representation. The computational operations used for this inspection are not predefined. Depending on the available evidence, the agent may generate scripts for point-cloud analysis, inspect selected images, visualize geometric information, estimate local reference directions, or apply geometric fitting procedures considered useful for characterizing the building.
blocks.zh: 特工首先检查现有图像,校准相机信息,以及稀疏的点云,以建立建筑物的初步解释. 这包括确定主要建筑表面、大约信封和屋顶配置以及与目标LOD3代表物有关的可见建筑构件。 本次检查所用的计算操作没有预先确定. 根据现有证据,代理商可以生成用于点-云分析的脚本,检查选定的图像,可视化几何信息,估计局部参考方向,或者应用被认为对建筑特征化有用的几何适配程序.

blocks.en: Based on the initial inspection, the agent generates a structured reconstruction plan before creating the building model. This plan is saved as reconstruction_plan.json within the reconstruction workspace and records the interpreted building planes and dimensions, roof configuration, architectural component inventory, and the image evidence supporting major components. The reconstruction plan therefore provides an explicit intermediate representation between interpretation of the observations and implementation of the building geometry in Blender.
blocks.zh: 根据初步检查,代理商在创建建筑模型之前会生成结构化的重建计划. 该计划作为重建计划保存在重建工作空间内,并记录了被解释的建筑平面和尺寸、屋顶配置、建筑构件清单以及支持主要构件的图像证据。 因此,重建计划为Blender建筑几何学的解释和实施提供了明确的中间表述.

blocks.en: The agent then generates Python code to construct the building programmatically in Blender. Geometry is created through executable procedures rather than through manual interaction with the Blender interface. The agent determines how individual architectural components are represented and may employ planar meshes, solids, extrusions, Boolean operations, repeated elements, profiles, or other low-complexity geometric constructions according to the observed building configuration. The resulting build_model.py program must be capable of regenerating the complete model from an empty Blender scene.
blocks.zh: 该代理随后生成Python代码,用于在Blender中程序构建该建筑. 几何是通过可执行程序创建的,而不是通过与Blender接口的人工交互. 代理人确定单个建筑构件是如何被表示的,并可能根据所观测到的建筑构型使用平面膜,固体,挤压,布尔操作,重复元素,剖面,或其他低复杂几何构造. 由此产生的build_model.py程序必须能够从空的Blender场景中重新生成完整的模型.

blocks.en: After the initial geometry is generated, representative calibrated cameras are imported into Blender and the model is rendered from the corresponding viewpoints. The resulting renders are inspected against the associated source photographs to identify inconsistencies in overall proportions, component placement, roof geometry, openings, and other reconstructed elements. The specific cameras selected for validation may depend on the building configuration, but the selected validation views are retained for the subsequent refinement cycles to provide a consistent basis for comparison.
blocks.zh: 初始几何生成后,代表性的校准相机被导入Blender,模型从相应的角度提供. 对照相关原始照片对结果进行了检查,以查明整体比例、组件布置、屋顶几何、开口和其他重建部分的不一致之处。 为验证所选择的特定相机可能取决于建筑物的配置,但选择的验证视图被保留给后续的完善周期,为比较提供一致的基础.

blocks.en: Following the initial validation, the agent may perform up to three geometry-refinement iterations. For each refinement, the agent modifies build_model.py , regenerates the model from an empty Blender scene, renders the same validation cameras, and inspects the remaining geometric inconsistencies. The refinement trajectory is therefore not fixed in advance but emerges from the intermediate reconstruction and validation results. Depending on the case, the agent may modify geometric parameters, component placement, opening dimensions, roof geometry, Boolean constructions, or other aspects of the procedural model considered inconsistent with the available evidence.
blocks.zh: 经初步审定后,代理机最多可进行3个几何-精度迭代. 对于每次改进,代理修改build_model.py,从空的Blender场景中再生模型,制造相同的验证相机,并检查剩余的几何不一致. 因此,改进轨道不是事先确定的,而是从中间重建和验证结果中得出的。 根据具体情况,代理人可以修改几何参数,组件放置,开口维度,屋顶几何,布尔构造,或者程序模型中被认为与现有证据不一致的其他方面.

blocks.en: After reconstruction and refinement are completed, the agent generates the required final model representations, executable reconstruction code, structured semantic and provenance information, and run documentation. Additional supporting files may also be produced according to the computational procedures followed during the reconstruction; unlike the required outputs, their type and organization can vary between runs. The resulting model representation and generated outputs are described in Section 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 重建和完善完成后,代理生成所需的最终模型表达,可执行重建代码,结构化语义和出处信息,并运行文档. 还可以根据重建过程中所遵循的计算程序制作额外的辅助文件;与所需产出不同,其类型和组织可能因运行而异. 第3.4节介绍了由此产生的模型表述和产出。

blocks.en: 3.4 Model representation and generated outputs
blocks.zh: 3.4 模型表述和产出

blocks.en:
As defined in Section 2 , the target reconstruction ℳ \mathcal{M} combines lightweight building geometry, semantic architectural information, component organization, and the evidence and provenance associated with the reconstructed elements.
In the implemented framework, these elements are distributed across the generated geometric models, executable reconstruction code, and structured metadata rather than being represented by a single mesh alone. The geometric representation contains the reconstructed architectural form, while the accompanying metadata records, for each major component, its identifier, semantic class, dimensions, position, supporting evidence references when available, and whether its geometry is directly observed or inferred.
blocks.zh:
如第2节所定义,目标重建M\mathcal{M}结合了轻量级建筑几何,语义建筑信息,组件组织,以及与重建元素相关的证据和来源.
在已实施的框架中,这些要素分布在生成的几何模型、可执行重建代码和结构化元数据之间,而不是仅用一个网格来表示。 几何表示法包含重建的建筑形式,而随附的元数据则记录了每个主要组成部分,其标识符,语义类,维度,位置,可用时的辅助证据参考,以及其几何是直接观测还是推断.

blocks.en: The reconstruction specification requires a standardized set of final deliverables for each reconstruction run: 1. model.blend , containing the Blender reconstruction; 2. model.glb , providing a portable binary glTF representation; 3. model.obj , providing a conventional mesh representation; 4. build_model.py , containing the executable procedural reconstruction; 5. reconstruction.json , containing component-level semantic, geometric, and provenance information; and 6. run_report.md , documenting the data used, reconstruction decisions, refinement process, geometry statistics, and unresolved ambiguities. This common set of outputs provides a consistent basis for storing, inspecting, and evaluating reconstructions across different building cases.
blocks.zh: 重建规格要求每个重建项目有一套标准化的最后交付品: 1. model.blend ,包含 Blender 重建;2. model.glb,提供便携式二进制 glTF 表示;3. model.obj,提供常规网格表示;4. building_model.py,包含可执行程序重建;5. building.json,包含组件级语义,几何和出处信息;6. run_report.md,记录使用的数据,重建决定,完善过程,几何统计,以及尚未解决的模糊之处. 这套共同产出为储存、检查和评价不同建筑的重建提供了一致的基础。

blocks.zh: 模型.blend,包含Blender重建;

blocks.en: model.glb , providing a portable binary glTF representation;
blocks.zh: 模型.glb,提供便携式二进制glTF表示;

blocks.en: The generated build_model.py provides an executable and inspectable representation of the geometric solution produced during a particular reconstruction run. When executed from an empty Blender scene, the script regenerates the corresponding final model without manual modeling operations. This property concerns the re-execution of an individual generated geometric solution and should be distinguished from deterministic repeatability of the complete agentic reconstruction process. Independent executions of AstraLOD3 with the same reconstruction evidence and reconstruction specification may follow different intermediate computational trajectories and may produce slightly different geometric solutions.
blocks.zh: 生成的build_model.py提供了在特定重建运行期间产生的几何溶液的可执行和可检查的表示. 当从一个空的Blender场景执行时,脚本会重新生成相应的最终模型,而无需手动建模操作. 这一财产涉及重新执行个人生成的几何解决方案,应当与完整的代理重建进程的确定性重复性区分开来。 具有同样重建证据和重建规格的AstraLOD3的独立处决可能遵循不同的中间计算轨迹,并可能产生略微不同的几何解决方案.

blocks.en: Beyond the required outputs, the agent may generate additional supporting files according to the needs of each reconstruction. These may include point-cloud analysis scripts, image rectifications, local coordinate representations, geometric audits, validation renders and overlays, camera checks, temporary Blender files, or other intermediate analysis products. Their type, number, and organization are not standardized and may vary between runs. AstraLOD3 therefore fixes the required reconstruction outputs while allowing the intermediate computational procedures and supporting files to adapt to the available evidence and the reconstructed building.
blocks.zh: 除了所需的产出外,代理商还可以根据每次重建的需要生成额外的辅助文件. 这些可能包括点云分析脚本、图像修正、局部坐标表示、几何审计、验证制成和叠加、照相机检查、临时Blender文件或其他中间分析产品。 它们的种类、数目和组织没有标准化,在运行期间可能有所不同。 AstraLOD3因此确定所需的重建产出,同时允许中间计算程序和辅助文件适应现有证据和已重建的建筑物。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental design
blocks.zh: 4 实验设计.

blocks.en: The experimental evaluation combines a broad building benchmark with a set of controlled experiments designed to examine different aspects of AstraLOD3. First, the reference configuration is evaluated across 24 buildings with different architectural characteristics and observation conditions. Controlled experiments then investigate the effect of the guidance provided through the reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} , the modalities available in the reconstruction evidence ℐ \mathcal{I} , and the Astra model configuration by comparing the Light , Medium , High , and Extra-High settings. Finally, an independent repeated reconstruction is used to examine run-to-run variability under the same experimental conditions. Together, these experiments comprise 35 reconstruction runs. The benchmark and reference configuration are introduced first, followed by the controlled experiments, evaluation metrics, and comparison protocol with previous reconstruction approaches.
blocks.zh: 实验评价结合了广义的建筑基准和一套控制实验,旨在检查AstraLOD3的不同方面. 首先,对具有不同建筑特征和观测条件的24座建筑进行了参考配置评价。 被控制的实验然后通过比较光,中,高,外高设置来调查通过重建规格 R\ mathcal{R} 提供的指导的效果,重建证据 I\ mathcal{I} 中可用的模式,以及Astra模型配置. 最后,在同样的实验条件下,利用独立的重复重建来检查运行中的变异性. 这些实验包括35次重建。 首先采用基准和参考配置,然后采用控制下的实验、评价指标以及与以往重建方法的比较协议。

blocks.zh: 4.1 基准案例和参考配置

Twenty-three correspond to real buildings represented by multi-view image and SfM datasets, covering different envelope configurations, roof geometries, opening arrangements, architectural styles, levels of occlusion, and degrees of geometric irregularity or damage. Building 24 is a controlled synthetic case originally modeled in Blender and subsequently processed through the same image-based SfM workflow used for the real cases.

blocks.en: 4.2 Controlled ablation and sensitivity experiments
blocks.zh: 4.2 受控衰竭和敏感度实验

blocks.en: Building 11, Gerlmerbahn, is used as the common case for the controlled ablation and sensitivity experiments. Its reference reconstruction is already included among the 24 benchmark cases and corresponds to the complete evidence configuration ℐ VCP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VCP}} , the Normal reconstruction specification, and the High Astra model configuration. Additional runs vary one experimental factor while keeping the remaining applicable conditions fixed. The experiments examine the amount of guidance encoded in the reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} , the modalities available through the reconstruction evidence ℐ \mathcal{I} , and the Astra model configuration. A separate repeated reconstruction of Building 03 is used to examine run-to-run variability. The complete experimental design is summarized in Table 3 .

blocks.en: Three variants of ℛ \mathcal{R} are considered to investigate how the level of human-provided guidance affects the reconstruction. The Normal specification corresponds to the complete formulation described in Section 3.2 and reproduced in A . In addition to the reconstruction objective, evidence and representation requirements, execution restrictions, and required outputs, it explicitly organizes the task into the six stages of evidence inspection, reconstruction planning, model generation, camera-based validation, iterative refinement, and finalization. The Short specification retains the reconstruction objective, architectural scope, evidence rules, geometric representation requirements, camera constraints, execution restrictions, and required outputs, but removes the prescribed staged workflow. The Nano specification further reduces the information provided in ℛ \mathcal{R} , retaining the reconstruction task, available inputs, principal zero-shot and data-access restrictions, and required outputs while leaving most geometric, semantic, and procedural decisions unspecified. The three variants therefore represent progressively less prescriptive reconstruction specifications rather than simply prompts of different textual length.
blocks.zh: R\mathcal{R}的三个变体被认为是用来调查人提供的指导水平如何影响重建. 正常规格与第3.2节所述和A节转载的完整配制一致。 除了重建目标、证据和陈述要求、执行限制和所需产出之外,它还明确将这项任务组织为证据检查、重建规划、模型生成、基于摄像机的验证、迭代完善和最后敲定等六个阶段。 短规格保留了重建目标,建筑范围,证据规则,几何表示要求,相机限制,执行限制,以及所需的产出,但取消了规定的分阶段工作流程. 纳诺规格进一步减少了R\ mathcal{R}中提供的信息,保留了重建任务,可用的投入,主要零镜头和数据访问限制,以及需要的产出,同时对大多数几何、语义和程序性决定未作说明。 因此,这三种变体代表的重建规格越来越不具有规范性,而不只是不同的文字长度。

Instructions that explicitly require a withheld modality are removed; for example, when images or camera information are unavailable, the corresponding image-inspection or camera-validation instructions are omitted. The remaining reconstruction objective, representation requirements, execution restrictions, and output requirements are retained whenever applicable. This design allows the agent to operate consistently with the evidence actually provided rather than receiving instructions that depend on unavailable inputs. The six configurations cover the relevant combinations containing visual evidence, geometric evidence, or both. blocks.en: Run-to-run variability is examined using Building 03, Petrinja school. Among the 24 reference reconstructions, this case required the longest processing time and represents one of the more architecturally extensive cases, with long façades, numerous repeated openings, projecting entrances, and a complex roof configuration. It was therefore selected as a demanding case with an extended reconstruction trajectory and substantial opportunities for agent-selected analysis, modeling, validation, and refinement decisions. Because repeating the complete benchmark multiple times would substantially increase the computational cost of the study, the variability analysis is limited to this case. A second reconstruction is initiated independently using the same ℐ VCP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VCP}} , Normal specification, and High Astra model configuration, allowing differences in processing time, computational trajectory, and final reconstruction to be examined under unchanged experimental conditions.

blocks.en: To summarize, starting from the 24 reference reconstructions, the controlled study adds two runs using the Short and Nano specifications, which progressively reduce the guidance encoded in ℛ \mathcal{R} , five runs that vary the modalities included in ℐ \mathcal{I} relative to the complete ℐ VCP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VCP}} configuration, and three runs that replace the reference High Astra model configuration with Light , Medium , or Extra-High . One additional independent reconstruction of Building 03 is included for the run-to-run variability analysis. Together, these experiments result in 35 reconstruction runs.

For buildings with corresponding models from previous work, the same geometric evaluation is applied after the required scale adjustment, as described in the following subsection.

blocks.zh: 4.4 与以往重建办法的比较

blocks.en: For 14 benchmark buildings, corresponding reconstructions are available from the earlier LOD3 [ 32 ] and DADT [ 31 ] studies. These cases are used to compare AstraLOD3 with the two purpose-built reconstruction approaches. blocks.en: 5 Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en: All 35 reconstruction runs produced the required final outputs. Following the experimental design introduced in Section 4 , the analysis first considers the 24-building reference benchmark and its comparison with the previous purpose-built reconstruction approaches. The controlled experiments are then used to examine the effect of the guidance encoded in ℛ \mathcal{R} , the modalities available in ℐ \mathcal{I} , the Astra model configuration, and run-to-run variability. Finally, the execution behavior observed across the experiments is discussed together with the main limitations of the framework.
blocks.zh: 所有35个重建项目都提供了所需的最后产出。 继第4节提出的试验性设计之后,分析首先考虑了24号建筑参考基准及其与以前专门设计的重建方法的比较。 然后使用控制实验来检查在R\ mathcal{R}中编码的导线的效果,I\ mathcal{I}中可用的模式,Astra模型配置,以及运行到运行的变异性. 最后,在整个实验中观察到的执行行为与框架的主要局限性一起讨论.

blocks.en: 5.1 Overall reconstruction performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 总体重建业绩

Across the benchmark, FRDS ranges from 0.9126 to 0.9937, with a mean of 0.9647 and a median of 0.9671. All cases obtain an FRDS above 0.90, and 19 of the 24 exceed 0.95.
