blocks.en: Processing time ranges from 12:32 to 38:47, with a mean of approximately 22:29 and a median of 21:23. It does not vary directly with the number of input images. For example, UNIL 2 contains 188 images and is reconstructed in 22:43, whereas Petrinja school contains 72 images and requires 38:47. The processing time therefore depends not only on the amount of input evidence but also on the computational operations selected during execution, the complexity of the geometric interpretation, and the validation and refinement performed for each building.
blocks.zh: 处理时间为12:32至38:47,平均值约为22:29,中位数为21:23. 它不随输入图像的数量而直接变化. 例如,UNIL 2包含188幅图像,重建于22:43,而Petrinja school包含72幅图像,需要38:47. 因此,处理时间不仅取决于输入证据的数量,还取决于执行过程中选择的计算操作,几何解释的复杂性,以及对每栋建筑进行的验证和完善.

blocks.en: Building 24 provides a useful controlled reference. Under the comparatively ideal conditions of the synthetic dataset, the reconstruction obtains the highest FRDS of the benchmark, 0.9937, indicating an almost complete agreement between the projected model and the reference building masks. Its D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} and IMF values should not, however, be compared directly with those of the other buildings because each SfM reconstruction has an independent scale. Moreover, even within an individual case, the geometric metrics are influenced by the composition of the sparse point cloud. For Building 24, the SfM cloud contains points belonging to the surrounding ground, which is excluded from the architectural reconstruction and therefore contributes to the measured point-cloud-to-model discrepancy. The opposite situation can also occur when architectural surfaces visible in the images, such as weakly textured roof regions, are reconstructed in the model but contain few corresponding SfM points. The geometric metrics should therefore be interpreted as measures of consistency with the available sparse reconstruction rather than as complete measures of architectural correctness.
blocks.zh: 24号楼提供了一个有用的控制参考。 在合成数据集相对理想的条件下,重建获得了基准中最高的FRDS,0.9937,表明预测模型与参考建筑口罩几乎完全一致. 然而,不应直接将其DCD D_{\mathrm{CD}}和IMF的数值与其他建筑物的数值进行比较,因为每个SfM重建都有一个独立的规模。 此外,即使在个别情况下,几何测量也受稀疏点云组成的影响. 对于24号楼,SfM云包含属于周围地面的点数,这些点数被排除在建筑重建之外,因此助长了测量到的点-云-模型差异. 当图像中可见的建筑表面,如纹理薄弱的屋顶区域,在模型中重建但包含很少对应的SfM点时,也可能出现相反的情况. 因此,几何测量标准应被解释为与现有的零星重建相一致的尺度,而不是建筑正确性的完整尺度。

blocks.en: Figure 3 provides representative qualitative examples supporting the quantitative evaluation. For each selected building, the reconstructed model is rendered from a calibrated camera and its projected contour is overlaid on the corresponding source image, providing a visual interpretation of the agreement measured by FRDS. The model is additionally shown together with the filtered sparse SfM point cloud, allowing the three-dimensional relationship underlying D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} and IMF to be inspected qualitatively. The examples show that the reconstructed envelopes generally follow both the image-supported building boundaries and the dominant point-cloud geometry, while local differences remain around simplified, weakly observed, or occluded regions.
blocks.zh: 图3提供了支持定量评价的有代表性的定性实例。 对于每个选定的建筑,重建的模型都是从一个校准的相机上渲染出来的,其投射的轮廓则覆盖在相应的源图像上,为FRDS测量的协议提供了视觉解释. 该模型与过滤过的稀疏SfM点云一起被额外显示,使得DCD D_{\mathrm{CD}} 和IMF的三维关系得到质量检查. 例子表明,重建的封套一般都遵循图像支持的建筑边界和占优势的点-云几何,而局部差异则仍然围绕着简化,弱观测,或渗漏的区域.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Representative qualitative validation of AstraLOD3 reconstructions. Each row shows a source image, the model rendered from the corresponding calibrated camera, the model-mask contour overlaid on the source image, and the model overlaid with the filtered sparse SfM point cloud. The contour and point-cloud comparisons provide qualitative counterparts to FRDS and the geometric metrics, respectively.
blocks.zh: 图3:具有代表性的AstraLOD3重建质量鉴定. 每行显示一个源图像,由相应的校准相机制成的模型,在源图像上的模型-掩模轮廓覆盖,以及被过滤的稀疏SfM点云的模型覆盖. 轮廓比较和点云比较分别提供了FRDS和几何度量衡的质量对应数据。

blocks.en: 5.2 Comparison with previous reconstruction approaches
blocks.zh: 5.2 与以往重建办法的比较

blocks.en: Table 5 compares AstraLOD3 with the corresponding models from the previous LOD3 [ 32 ] and DADT [ 31 ] studies. As described in Section 4.4 , the geometric metrics are evaluated at a common scale for each corresponding building.
blocks.zh: 表5 比较 AstraLOD3与之前LOD3[32]和DADT[31]研究的相应模型. 如第4.4节所述,每座相应建筑物的几何计量标准均按共同尺度加以评价。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Quantitative comparison between AstraLOD3 and corresponding models from the previous LOD3 [ 32 ] and DADT [ 31 ] studies. Higher FRDS and lower D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} and IMF indicate greater agreement. Point cloud metrics are compared at a common scale for each building.
blocks.zh: 表5:AstraLOD3与以往LOD3[32]和DADT[31]研究中相应模型的定量比较。 较高的FRDS和较低的DCD D_{\mathrm{CD}}和IMF表示更大的一致. 点云度量衡按每栋建筑的通用尺度进行比较.

blocks.en: The comparison shows stronger image-space agreement overall. AstraLOD3 obtains a higher FRDS for nearly all overlapping cases, while the geometric metrics remain more mixed. The only exception in FRDS is Ozcan, for which the two values are almost identical (0.9126 and 0.9150). As illustrated in Figure 4 , AstraLOD3 reconstructs several architectural elements at a finer level of geometric detail than the previous models, including balconies, railings, roof elements, openings, chimneys, and local façade components. In cases such as Ozcan, these thin or open components can introduce small differences in the projected binary mask compared with the more compact representation used in the previous reconstruction, even when the resulting geometry is visually consistent with the source images.
blocks.zh: 比较显示,总的来说,图像空间协议更加有力。 阿斯特拉语Name LOD3在几乎所有重叠的病例中都获得了更高的FRDS,而几何测量值仍然比较混合. FRDS中唯一的例外是Ozcan,这两个值几乎相同(0.9126和0.9150). 如图4所示,AstraLOD3在几何细节的更细的层次上重建了若干建筑元素,包括瓦房、栏杆、屋顶元素、开口、烟囱和局部外观组件。 在Ozcan等情况下,这些薄薄或开放的组件可以与之前重建中使用的更紧凑的表示相比,在预测的二进制面具中引入小差异,即使由此产生的几何图形在视觉上与源图像一致.

blocks.en: The point-cloud-based metrics require a more careful interpretation. In several cases, AstraLOD3 provides geometric agreement comparable to or better than the previous reconstructions, while in others the previous models obtain lower distances. Part of this variation arises from differences in both the reconstructed representation and the point clouds used for evaluation. In the previous studies, the SfM point clouds were manually cleaned to retain observations closely associated with the building, whereas the present workflow uses automatic statistical and spatial filtering. Although this removes most surrounding observations without manual intervention, residual ground, vegetation, clutter, damaged material, or other non-building points can remain and contribute to the measured distances. For IMF, the inlier criterion reduces the influence of the larger-distance tail but does not completely eliminate this effect.
blocks.zh: 基于点云的衡量标准需要更仔细的解释。 在一些情况下,AstraLOD3提供了与以前的重建相比或更好的几何协议,而在另一些情况下,以前的模型获得的距离更低. 这种差异部分来自重新调整的代表和用于评价的点云之间的差异。 在之前的研究中,SfM点云被人工清理,以保留与大楼密切相关的观测,而目前的工作流程则使用自动统计和空间过滤. 虽然这消除了大多数周围的观测,而无需人工干预,但残余的地面、植被、杂乱无章、受损的材料或其他非建筑点仍然可能存在,并且有助于测量距离。 对IMF来说,更强的标准降低了较大距离尾巴的影响,但并没有完全消除这种影响.

blocks.en: The symmetric Chamfer distance is additionally sensitive to architectural surfaces reconstructed from the images but weakly represented in the sparse SfM cloud. Components such as chimneys, roof regions, balconies, railings, or other detailed elements can therefore increase the model-to-cloud term despite being supported by the visual evidence. The relatively small differences observed for many cases should consequently be interpreted in the context of both the richer geometric representation produced by AstraLOD3 and the less manually curated point-cloud preprocessing used in the present workflow.
blocks.zh: 对称的Chamfer距离对从图像中重建的建筑表面具有额外的敏感性,但在稀疏的SfM云中却表现得微弱. 因此,烟囱,屋顶区域,瓦房,栏杆等部件或其他详细元素,尽管有视觉证据支持,仍可以增加模型到云的术语. 因此,对许多案例观察到的相对小的差别,应该从AstraLOD3生成的较丰富的几何表示和本工作流程中使用的手动处理较少的点云预处理的角度来解释。

blocks.en: The quantitative comparison should therefore be interpreted together with the qualitative results in Figure 4 . The previous LOD3 models generally provide more compact representations of the main building envelope, while AstraLOD3 recovers a larger number of image-supported architectural components. A similar trend is visible in the DADT cases, where AstraLOD3 reconstructs the principal geometry together with additional architectural detail while also preserving irregular or damaged building configurations when these are supported by the observations. Particularly favorable geometric agreement is obtained in cases such as Petrinja school, UNIL, and Gerlmerbahn, whereas other cases illustrate the expected trade-off between geometric detail and support from a sparse point cloud.
blocks.zh: 因此,定量比较应与图4中的定性结果一并解释。 之前的LOD3模型一般为主楼信封提供更紧凑的表示,而AstraLOD3则回收了更多图像支持的建筑组件. DADT案也出现了类似趋势,AstraLOD3重建了主几何结构,并增加了建筑细节,同时在观测结果支持的情况下保留了不规则或损坏的建筑配置。 在Petrinja school、UNIL和Gerlmerbahn等案件中获得特别有利的几何协议,而其他案例则说明了几何细节与从稀疏的云端得到的支持之间的预期权衡。

blocks.en: Overall, the comparison indicates that AstraLOD3 achieves comparable geometric agreement and generally stronger image-space agreement than the previous purpose-built approaches, while recovering a more detailed architectural representation in several of the evaluated cases. Importantly, these models are obtained without relying on the task-specific reconstruction procedures developed for the previous LOD3 and DADT pipelines.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,比较表明,AstraLOD3在几何上达成了可比较的几何协议,并且一般比以往的预定建造方法更强有力的图像空间协议,同时在几个受评价的案件中恢复了更详细的建筑代表性. 重要的是,这些模型是在不依赖为以前LOD3和DADT管道制定的针对具体任务的重建程序的情况下取得的。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Qualitative comparison of AstraLOD3 with the corresponding DADT [ 31 ] reconstructions (left) and previous LOD3 [ 32 ] reconstructions (right). For each building, a representative source image is shown together with the AstraLOD3 and previous reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 图4:AstraLOD3与相应的DADT[31]重建(左)和以前的LOD3[32]重建(右)的定性比较. 每座建筑都与AstraLOD3和以前的重建一起显示一个有代表性的源图像.

blocks.en: 5.3 Effect of reconstruction-specification guidance
blocks.zh: 5.3 具体重建指南的效果

blocks.en: The effect of the guidance encoded in ℛ \mathcal{R} is examined using the Normal , Short , and Nano specifications while retaining the same Gerlmerbahn evidence ℐ VCP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VCP}} and Astra High model configuration. As described in Section 4.2 , the Normal specification provides the complete reconstruction requirements together with the prescribed six-stage workflow. The Short specification retains the reconstruction objective, evidence and representation rules, camera constraints, and output requirements, but removes the explicit workflow. The Nano specification further reduces ℛ \mathcal{R} to the reconstruction task, available inputs, principal execution restrictions, and required outputs, leaving most geometric, semantic, and procedural decisions to the agent.
blocks.zh: R\mathcal{R}中编码的制导效果通过正常,短,纳诺的规格来检查,同时保留相同的Gerlmerbahn证据 I VCP\mathcal{I}_{\ mathrm{VCP}}和Astra High模型配置. 如第4.2节所述,正常规格提供了完整的重建要求以及规定的六阶段工作流程。 短规格保留了重建目标,证据和表现规则,镜头限制,以及产出要求,但取消了明确的工作流程. Nano规格进一步将R\mathcal{R}减少为重建任务,可用投入,主要执行限制,以及所需产出,将大多数几何,语义,程序决定留给代理人.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Effect of the guidance encoded in the reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} on the Gerlmerbahn reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 表6:重建规格R\mathcal{R}中编码的指南对Gerlmerbahn重建的影响。

blocks.en: The results show that reconstruction performance does not vary monotonically with the amount of guidance provided through ℛ \mathcal{R} . The Short specification achieves the strongest quantitative agreement, with the highest FRDS and the lowest D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} and IMF, although it also requires the longest processing time. This result suggests that removing the prescribed workflow can provide useful flexibility when the reconstruction objective and geometric and evidence constraints remain clearly defined. In this run, the agent independently organized the reconstruction around plane fitting, calibrated image measurements, roof and opening refinement, and multi-view correction of the chimney and lower building boundaries. The final model retained open ground boundaries where the building was concealed by the slope rather than completing unsupported foundation geometry.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,重建表现与通过R\ mathcal{R}提供的指导数量并不单调. Short规格实现了最强的量化协议,其中FRDS最高,DCDD_{\mathrm{CD}}}和IMF最低,虽然它也需要最长的处理时间. 这一结果表明,如果重建目标以及几何和证据方面的限制仍然明确界定,取消规定的工作流程就能提供有益的灵活性。 在这次运行中,特工独立组织围绕飞机装配,校准图像测量,屋顶和开口精细,以及烟囱和下层建筑边界的多景校正. 最终的模型保留了露天的地面边界,其中建筑物被斜坡隐藏,而不是完成无根据的地基几何.

blocks.en: The Nano experiment illustrates a different effect of increased autonomy. With most geometric and procedural guidance removed, the agent still reconstructed the main building and architectural components, but it also made additional representation choices not prescribed in the Normal or Short specifications. In particular, it generated source-derived façade textures and included additional geometric interpretation of concealed lower portions of the building. The photographic appearance visible in Figure 5 therefore emerged from the agent’s own interpretation of the reconstruction task rather than from an explicit texture-generation requirement.
blocks.zh: 纳诺实验说明了增强自主性的不同效果. 随着大部分几何和程序性指导被移除,代理商仍然重建了主要建筑和建筑构件,但也做出了正常或短规格中未规定的额外的表示选择. 特别是,它产生了来源的外观纹理,并增加了对建筑物中隐藏的下部的几何解释。 因此,图5中可见的图片外观来自代理人自己对重建任务的解释,而不是明确的纹理生成要求。

blocks.en: The additional freedom does not necessarily improve the evaluation metrics. In the Nano reconstruction, a shallow lower closure and rear wall surfaces were introduced in regions concealed by the rising terrain. Such completion can be architecturally plausible while reducing agreement with the evaluation evidence: surfaces visible in the rendered model but occluded in the source images can reduce FRDS, while reconstructed surfaces with little or no support in the sparse point cloud can increase the model-to-cloud contribution of the symmetric Chamfer distance. The comparatively small change in IMF is consistent with its one-sided formulation, which is less directly affected by additional model surfaces.
blocks.zh: 额外的自由并不一定能改进评价的衡量标准。 在纳诺重建中,在地势上升所掩盖的地区引入了较浅的下关和后墙表面. 这种完成在结构上是可信的,同时减少了与评价证据的一致:在制成的模型中可见但源图像中隐蔽的表面可以减少FRDS,而在稀疏点云中很少或根本没有支持的重建表面可以增加对称查姆费尔距离的模型对云的贡献. 货币基金组织的相对小的变化与其片面的表述一致,后者较少受到更多模型表面的直接影响.

blocks.en: The three experiments therefore indicate that increasing agent autonomy changes not only the computational procedure but also how the reconstruction problem itself is interpreted. The Short specification appears to provide a useful balance for this case: it preserves the geometric and evidence constraints of the full specification while allowing the agent to determine its own reconstruction procedure. The Nano case demonstrates that substantially weaker guidance can still produce a plausible and richer representation, but also allows reasonable inferred content that is not necessarily favored by the selected evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 因此,这三项实验表明,增加代理自主不仅改变了计算程序,而且改变了重建问题本身的解释。 简短的规格似乎为本案提供了有益的平衡:它保留了完全规格的几何和证据限制,同时允许代理人决定自己的重建程序. 纳诺案表明,指导大大弱化,仍可产生合理和丰富的代表性,但也允许合理推断的内容,而这种推断不一定受到选定评价指标的青睐。

blocks.en: 5.4 Effect of reconstruction evidence
blocks.zh: 5.4 重建证据的效果

blocks.en: Table 7 reports the Gerlmerbahn reconstructions obtained using the six evidence configurations defined in Eq. 6 . The complete configuration ℐ VCP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VCP}} provides the strongest overall quantitative agreement, with the highest FRDS and the lowest symmetric Chamfer distance. The lowest IMF is obtained with ℐ CP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{CP}} , although its value is close to that of the complete configuration.
blocks.zh: 表7报告了使用第6条定义的六个证据组合获得的Gerlmerbahn重建项目。 完整的配置 I VCP\mathcal{I}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{VCP}}}提供了最强的整体定量协议,其中FRDS最高,对称的Chamfer距离最低. 最低的IMF是用 ICP \ mathcal{I}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{CP}}}获得的,尽管其价值接近于完整的配置.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Effect of the reconstruction evidence available to the Astra agent for Building 11. A dash indicates that the image-only reconstruction does not share the SfM coordinate system and scale required for direct quantitative comparison.
blocks.zh: 表7: Astra大楼11号大楼代理商可获得的重建证据的效果。 一个破折号表示,仅图像重建并不共享直接定量比较所需的SfM坐标系统和比例.

blocks.en: The quantitative and qualitative results show complementary roles for the three evidence modalities. Photographs provide important information for identifying architectural components and finer details, whereas the sparse point cloud directly constrains the three-dimensional building geometry. Accordingly, the reconstructions containing 𝒱 \mathcal{V} generally preserve features such as the chimney, shutters, exterior stair, and more detailed window and door configurations. When photographs are unavailable, as in ℐ CP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{CP}} and ℐ P \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{P}} , the principal envelope, tower, roof configuration, and several openings are still recovered, but the resulting models are more simplified. The point-cloud-only case is particularly notable: despite relying only on sparse geometric evidence, the agent recovers the main building configuration and several architectural openings, while omitting components such as the chimney for which sufficient geometric support is not found.
blocks.zh: 定量和定性结果表明三种证据模式的互补作用。 照片为识别建筑构件和细微细节提供了重要信息,而稀疏的点云直接制约了三维建筑几何. 因此,包含 V\mathcal{V} 的重建一般保存烟囱,百叶窗,外楼梯,以及更详细的窗口和门配置等特征. 当照片无法获取时,如I CP \ mathcal{I}_{\ mathrm{CP}}}和I P \mathcal{I}_{\ mathrm{P}}}中,主信封,塔楼,屋顶配置,以及几个开口仍然被回收,但由此产生的模型更加简化. 唯点云型案例尤其显著:尽管只依靠稀疏的几何证据,但特工还是恢复了主建筑配置和几个建筑开口,同时省略了烟囱等没有找到足够几何支持的部件.

blocks.en: Calibrated cameras provide the link between visual observations and the three-dimensional reference frame. This is particularly evident for ℐ VC \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VC}} : in the absence of a supplied point cloud, according the output report, the agent generated image correspondences and triangulated new three-dimensional observations from the calibrated photographs before fitting the building geometry. In contrast, ℐ VP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VP}} provides both photographs and sparse geometry but no calibrated relationship between them. The agent can therefore use the images to interpret architectural components and the point cloud to constrain the main geometry, but cannot directly transfer image observations into the SfM coordinate system. This helps explain why ℐ VP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VP}} remains visually detailed while producing lower FRDS and a larger D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} than the complete configuration.
blocks.zh: 校准相机提供视觉观测与三维参考框架之间的联系. 这对I VC\mathcal{I}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{VC}}}特别明显:在没有提供点云的情况下,根据输出报告,代理生成图像对应,并在安装建筑几何之前从校准的照片中三角化新的三维观测. 相比之下,I VP\mathcal{I}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{VP}}}既提供了照片,也提供了稀疏的几何特征,但没有校准它们之间的关系. 因此,代理可以使用图像来解释建筑组件和点云来约束主几何,但不能直接将图像观测转移到SfM坐标系统中. 这有助于解释为什么I VP\mathcal{I}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{VP}}}在生产更低的FRDS和更大的DCD D_{\mathrm{CD}}时,仍保持视觉细节.

blocks.en: The behavior of the metrics is also consistent with the effects observed in Sections 5.2 and 5.3 . Architectural components recovered from the images can be weakly represented in the sparse point cloud and therefore increase the model-to-cloud contribution of D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} . In addition, some runs infer portions of the building hidden by the surrounding slope, while others terminate the geometry closer to the directly observed envelope. Such inferred surfaces can be architecturally plausible but are not represented in the visible image masks and may have little or no support in the sparse cloud, thereby reducing FRDS or increasing D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} . Conversely, the simpler ℐ CP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{CP}} and ℐ P \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{P}} reconstructions remain close to the dominant point-supported surfaces and consequently obtain low IMF values despite containing fewer architectural details.
blocks.zh: 衡量标准的行为也与第5.2节和第5.3节中观察到的效果一致。 从图像中恢复的建筑构件在稀疏点云中可以被弱化地表示,从而增加D CD D_{\ mathrm{ CD}} 的模型对云的贡献. 此外,有些会推断周围斜坡所隐藏的建筑部分,而另一些会终止接近直接观测到的信封的几何学. 这种推断的表面在建筑学上是可信的,但在可见的图像面具中却没有体现,在稀疏的云层中可能几乎没有或根本没有支持,从而减少了FRDS或增加了DCD D_{\ mathrm{CD}} 。 相反,更简单的I CP \ mathcal{I}_{\ mathrm{CP}} 和 I P \ mathcal{I}_{\ mathrm{P}} 重建仍然接近于占支配地位的点支持面,因此,尽管建筑细节较少,但IMF的价值仍然很低。

blocks.en: The image-only configuration ℐ V \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{V}} represents the limiting case. Without calibrated cameras or an SfM point cloud, the agent still produces a recognizable reconstruction, including the main building, tower, roof, chimney, openings, and exterior stair. However, its scale and coordinate system are independently inferred, and Figure 6 shows larger differences in the relative geometry of the tower and main building. A direct FRDS or point-cloud comparison in the common SfM frame would therefore require an additional external alignment and is not reported here.
blocks.zh: 仅图像配置 I V\ mathcal{ IQQ mathrm{V} 代表限制大小写 。 没有校准的摄像头或SfM点云,该剂仍然产生可识别的重建,包括主楼,塔楼,屋顶,烟囱,开口,外楼梯. 然而,它的尺度和坐标系统是独立推断的,图6显示了塔和主楼相对几何的较大差异. 因此,在通用的SfM框架中进行直接的FRDS或点云比较将需要额外的外部对齐,本文不作报告。

blocks.en: Overall, the ablation shows that removing an evidence modality changes not only the information available to the agent but also the computational procedure used to reconstruct the building. Depending on the available inputs, the agent shifts between calibrated multi-view triangulation, point-cloud fitting and geometric analysis, or image-based architectural interpretation. The complete ℐ VCP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VCP}} configuration provides the strongest overall result because visual, geometric, and camera information can be jointly used during reconstruction, validation, and refinement. Figure 6 illustrates the corresponding differences in the reconstructed models.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,取消证据模式不仅会改变代理人可获得的信息,而且会改变重建大楼所用的计算程序。 根据可获得的输入,代理在校准的多视三角形,点云装配和几何分析,或基于图像的建筑解释之间转移. 完整的I VCP \ mathcal{IQQ mathrm{VCP}}配置提供了最强的整体效果,因为视觉,几何,相机信息可以在重建,验证,完善过程中共同使用. 图6显示重建模型的相应差异。

blocks.en: The four configurations recover the same principal architectural organization, and the qualitative differences in Figure 7 are relatively small compared with those observed in the evidence ablation. The main building, tower, roof configuration, chimney, openings, and exterior stair are reproduced across the four runs, although local differences remain in the placement and representation of individual components and in the treatment of the lower envelope.
blocks.zh: 四个配置恢复了相同的主要建筑结构,与证据衰减中观察到的相比,图7的质量差异相对较小. 主楼,塔楼,屋顶布置,烟囱,开口,外层楼梯在四条跑道上进行复制,不过在单个构件的布置和代表以及下层信封的处理方面仍存在着局部差异.

blocks.en: The quantitative results show a clearer separation. High and Extra-High provide substantially higher FRDS and lower geometric discrepancies than Light and Medium . Extra-High obtains the highest FRDS and lowest IMF, whereas High produces the lowest symmetric Chamfer distance. As observed in the preceding experiments, part of this difference is influenced by how each run treats geometry hidden by the surrounding slope. More extensive inferred lower surfaces have limited support in the visible image masks and sparse point cloud and can consequently reduce FRDS or increase D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} even when the completion is geometrically plausible.
blocks.zh: 量化结果表明,这种区分更为明确。 高和超高提供了比轻和中低得多的FRDS和几何差异。 外高获得最高的FRDS和最低的IMF,而高高则产生最低的对称的Chamfer距离. 正如前面的实验所观察到的,这种差异的一部分受到每个运行如何对待周围斜坡隐藏的几何的影响. 较广的推断下表面在可见的图像面具和稀释点云中支持有限,因此可以减少FRDS或增加D CD D_{\ mathrm{ CD}},即使完成的几何合理.

blocks.en: Processing time does not vary monotonically with the Astra configuration. Medium is the fastest run at 11:33, whereas Light requires 23:27 despite using a lower configuration. High completes in 20:00, while Extra-High requires the longest time, 29:28. The run reports also show different use of the permitted refinement budget: Light performs one geometry-refinement iteration, Medium two, and High and Extra-High three. These observations suggest that the model configuration can influence not only the resulting geometry but also the computational trajectory and the extent of refinement performed during the run.
blocks.zh: Astra 配置的处理时间并不单调。 中程是运行最快的11:33,而光需要23:27,尽管使用较低的配置. High在20:00完成,而Extra-High则需要最长的时间29:28. 运行报告还显示对允许的完善预算的不同用途: 光执行一个几何-精度迭代,中二,高和超高三. 这些观察表明,模型配置不仅可以影响由此产生的几何,还可以影响计算轨迹和运行过程中的改进程度.

blocks.en: For this case, the qualitative similarity among the four reconstructions indicates that the lower configurations can already recover the principal LOD3 building structure, while High and Extra-High provide stronger quantitative agreement and somewhat more refined local geometry. Medium additionally demonstrates that a comparatively short execution can still produce a plausible reconstruction. However, these results correspond to one independent execution per configuration, and processing time and reconstruction quality can also vary between repeated agentic runs.
blocks.zh: 在这种情况下,四个重建项目之间的质的相似性表明,较低的配置已经能够恢复主要的LOD3建筑结构,而High and Extra-High则提供了更强有力的量化协议,并在一定程度上改进了当地的几何结构. 中等程度上还表明,相对短暂的处决仍可产生可信的重建。 然而,这些结果对应每个配置一个独立执行,处理时间和重建质量也可能因重复的代理运行而异.

blocks.en: 5.6 Run-to-run variability
blocks.zh: 5.6 运行中的可变性

blocks.en: Building 03, Petrinja school, was selected for the repeated-run experiment because it required the longest processing time among the 24 reference reconstructions and represents one of the more architecturally extensive cases, with long façades, numerous repeated openings, projecting entrances, courtyard returns, and a complex roof configuration. It therefore provides a demanding case for examining whether independent executions under unchanged conditions follow similar reconstruction trajectories and produce comparable final models. Both runs use the same complete evidence ℐ VCP \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{VCP}} , Normal reconstruction specification, and Astra High model configuration. Their quantitative results are reported in Table 9 .
blocks.zh: 03号楼,Petrinja学校被选入了重复运行的实验,因为它需要24个参考重建中最长的处理时间,并且代表了建筑范围更广的病例之一,外观长,多次打开,投影入口,庭院回归,以及复杂的屋顶配置. 因此,它为审查在不变条件下的独立处决是否遵循类似的重建轨迹并产生可比较的最终模式提供了一个严格的理由。 两个运行都使用相同的完整证据 I VCP\ mathcal{I}_{\Q}_{\mathrm{VCP}}},正常重建规格,以及Astra High模型配置. 其量化结果见表9。

blocks.zh: 表9:在相同的实验条件下,03号楼的两个独立的AstraLOD3重建.

blocks.en: Both executions recover the same principal building organization and major architectural components, and both use the maximum of three permitted geometry-refinement iterations. Nevertheless, the computational trajectories differ. According to the run reports, Run 1 uses six representative calibrated views during validation, whereas Run 2 selects seven validation views. Run 2 also requires approximately 3.5 minutes more processing time. These differences show that identical evidence and reconstruction requirements do not lead the agent through an identical sequence of analysis, validation, and refinement operations.
blocks.zh: 两次处决都恢复了同样的主要建筑组织和主要建筑构件,并且都使用了最多3个允许的几何修饰迭代. 尽管如此,计算轨迹不同. 根据运行报告,Run 1在验证过程中使用6个具有代表性的校准视图,而Run 2则选择7个验证视图. 2号运行还需要约3.5分钟的处理时间. 这些差异表明,同样的证据和重建要求并不导致代理人通过一个相同的分析、验证和精炼作业序列。

blocks.en: The final quantitative results also vary, with Run 1 obtaining higher FRDS and lower D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} and IMF. With only two independent executions, these differences should not be interpreted as a systematic advantage of either trajectory. Qualitatively, both runs reproduce the overall massing, roof configuration, opening rhythm, entrances, and other principal components, as shown in Figure 8 . Local differences remain in the representation and placement of individual elements, and Run 2 contains a visible inclination in one façade region that is not present in Run 1. Such a local error could potentially be addressed through additional autonomous refinement or through a subsequent user-directed correction, but neither was permitted in this experiment in order to maintain the same bounded reconstruction protocol.
blocks.zh: 最后的量化结果也各不相同,运行1号获得了更高的FRDS和较低的DCD D_{\mathrm{CD}}和IMF. 由于只有两次独立处决,这些差别不应被解释为两种轨迹的系统性优势。 如图8所示,在质量上,两者都复制整体的块状、屋顶配置、开口节奏、入口和其他主要部件。 各地在个别元素的表示和布置上仍存在差异,运行2包含在运行1中不存在的一个外观区域的明显倾角. 这种局部错误有可能通过进一步的自主改进或通过随后由用户指导的校正来解决,但为了维持同样的有界限的重建协议,这次实验不允许这样做.

blocks.en: This variability is distinct from the re-executability of an individual generated solution. Once a run produces its final build_model.py , the corresponding model can be regenerated from an empty Blender scene using the fixed script and parameters. A new Astra execution, however, can select different intermediate analyses, validation views, geometric parameterizations, and refinement decisions. The experiment therefore shows that the procedural output of an individual run is re-executable, while the complete agentic reconstruction process is not deterministic.
blocks.zh: 这种可变性不同于个人生成的解决方案的可重新执行性。 一旦运行产生其最终的构建_model.py,相应的模型可以使用固定的脚本和参数从空的Blender场景中重新生成. 然而,新的Astra执行可以选择不同的中间分析,验证视图,几何参数化,以及完善决定. 因此实验表明,单个运行的程序输出可以重新执行,而完整的代理重建过程则不能确定.

blocks.en: 5.7 Agentic behavior and limitations
blocks.zh: 5.7 代理行为和限制

blocks.en: Taken together, the experiments show a consistent distinction between the reconstruction requirements defined before execution and the computational trajectory followed by the agent. The required final outputs were produced across all runs, whereas the intermediate analyses, reconstruction plans, supporting files, validation choices, and refinement operations varied between buildings and experimental configurations. The computational procedures also adapted to the observed architecture: predominantly planar buildings were commonly treated using plane fitting, local architectural coordinates, rectified façade views, and image–geometry intersections, whereas more irregular, curved, or damaged buildings required different geometric interpretations and representations. This behavior is consistent with the bounded-autonomy formulation of AstraLOD3: the objective, evidence, constraints, and output contract are specified through ℛ \mathcal{R} , while the computational procedures used to satisfy them are determined during execution.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些实验表明,在执行前界定的重建要求与代理人所遵循的计算轨迹之间有着一贯的区别。 所需的最后产出是在所有各行各业产生的,而中间分析、重建计划、辅助文件、验证选择和改良业务则因建筑物和实验配置而异。 计算程序也适应了观测到的建筑结构:通常使用平面配置、当地建筑坐标、校正外观和图像-几何交叉面来对待主要是平面建筑,而更不规则、弯曲或损坏的建筑则需要不同的几何解释和表述。 这种行为与AstraLOD3的边框自定义配方一致:通过R\mathcal{R}指定了目标,证据,约束,和输出合同,而用于满足它们的计算程序则在执行过程中确定.

blocks.en: Iterative validation and refinement are an important part of this process. Across the experiments, subsequent iterations corrected issues involving roof intersections, façade extents, opening dimensions and placement, stairs or balconies, lower-envelope geometry, and implementation errors in the generated procedural models. The maximum of three geometry-refinement iterations was imposed as an experimental constraint to bound processing time and maintain comparable conditions across runs, rather than as an indication that the reconstruction had fully converged. Some remaining local discrepancies, including the inclined façade observed in the second Petrinja-school run, suggest that additional autonomous iterations could further improve individual models. A complementary extension would be user-directed refinement, in which the generated model and calibrated evidence are retained and the agent is asked to correct specific components after the autonomous reconstruction has finished.
blocks.zh: 模拟验证和完善是这一进程的一个重要部分。 在整个实验中,随后的迭代纠正了涉及屋顶十字路口、表面范围、开口尺寸和放置、楼梯或瓦片、低信封几何以及生成的程序模型中的执行错误等问题。 3个几何-精度迭代的上限是作为约束处理时间和在全程保持可比条件的实验性限制,而不是作为重建完全汇合的标志. 当地仍然存在的一些差异,包括在第二次Petrinja学校运行中观察到的倾斜外观,表明额外的自主迭代可以进一步改善个别模式。 辅助性扩展将是用户指导的改进,其中保留生成的模型和校准证据,并要求代理人在自主重建完成后纠正具体部件。

blocks.en: The results are also limited by the information contained in the reconstruction evidence and by the evaluation itself. The SfM datasets do not generally provide an absolute physical scale, sparse point clouds can contain residual ground, vegetation, clutter, or damaged material, and roofs or other weakly textured surfaces may contain limited geometric support. Similarly, occlusion by terrain, vegetation, or other objects leaves portions of the building unobserved. In such cases, the agent may simplify the geometry or infer plausible hidden surfaces; these inferred elements are recorded through the observed/inferred provenance but should not be interpreted as survey-grade measurements of unobserved construction. The reported FRDS, D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} , and IMF values should therefore be interpreted as complementary measures of consistency with the available image and SfM evidence rather than as complete measures of three-dimensional architectural accuracy.
blocks.zh: 重建证据中的信息和评价本身也限制了结果。 SfM数据集一般不会提供绝对的物理尺度,稀疏的点云可以包含残留的地面,植被,杂质,或损坏的材料,而屋顶或其他微弱纹理的表面可能包含有限的几何支撑. 同样,由于地形、植被或其他物体的遮蔽,建筑物的部分部分无法观察。 在这种情况下,物剂可以简化几何或推断出可能隐藏的表面;这些推断要素是通过观测/推断出的地方记录的,但不应被解释为对未观察构造的勘测级测量。 因此,所报告的FRDS、D CD D_{\ mathrm{CD}} 和IMF的数值应被解释为与现有图像和SfM证据一致的补充衡量标准,而不是三维建筑精确度的完整衡量标准。

blocks.en: Overall, the contribution of AstraLOD3 is not a new geometric primitive or a fixed reconstruction algorithm, but a constrained agentic formulation in which a general-purpose multimodal model can select and combine computational procedures to produce a common structured LOD3 representation across heterogeneous building cases. The results show that this formulation can operate under different levels of guidance and reduced evidence, while the ablation and repeated-run experiments also reveal variability in execution time, intermediate decisions, and final geometric details. These characteristics define both the capabilities and the current limitations of the proposed approach and motivate further work on adaptive refinement, user-guided correction, and more explicit reconstruction of damage and other application-specific architectural information.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,AstraLOD3的贡献并不是一种新的几何原始或固定的重建算法,而是一种受限的代理配方,在这种配方中,通用的多式联运模型可以选择和结合计算程序,以产生一个不同建筑案例的通用结构化LOD3代表. 结果显示,这种配体可以在不同的指导水平下运行,证据减少,而衰减和重复运行的实验也揭示了执行时间,中间决定,以及最终几何细节的变异性. 这些特点界定了拟议办法的能力和目前的局限性,并激励进一步开展适应性改进、用户引导的校正、更明确的重建损害和其他具体应用的建筑信息方面的工作。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: This study introduced AstraLOD3, a zero-shot multimodal agentic framework for automated reconstruction of lightweight and semantically structured LOD3 building models. The framework combines reconstruction evidence ℐ = { 𝒱 , 𝒞 , 𝒫 } \mathcal{I}=\{\mathcal{V},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{P}\} , comprising multi-view images, calibrated camera information, and a filtered sparse SfM point cloud, with a human-defined reconstruction specification ℛ \mathcal{R} . Rather than prescribing a complete reconstruction algorithm, ℛ \mathcal{R} defines the objective, evidence rules, representation requirements, execution constraints, procedural guidance, and required outputs. Operating under bounded autonomy, the Astra agent determines the computational procedures required for each case, including data inspection, geometric analysis, code generation, Blender-based model construction, validation, and iterative refinement. The reconstruction task is performed without task-specific training or fine-tuning, building-specific pretrained reconstruction pipelines, external 3D assets, ground-truth geometry, or manual correction during execution.
blocks.zh: 这项研究引入了AstraLOD3,一种用于轻量级和精密结构的LOD3建筑模型自动重建的零射多式代理框架. 框架结合了重建证据I={V,C,P}\mathcal{I}=\{\mathcal{V},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{P},包括多视图图像,校准相机信息,以及过滤的稀疏的SfM点云,以及人定义的重建规格R\mathcal{R}. R\mathcal{R}没有规定完整的重建算法,而是定义了目标、证据规则、陈述要求、执行限制、程序指导和所需产出。 Astra代理公司在受约束的自主权下运作,确定每个案件所需的计算程序,包括数据检查、几何分析、代码生成、基于Blender的模型构建、验证和迭代改进。 执行重建任务时,没有具体任务的培训或微调,没有具体建筑物事先训练的重建管道,没有外部3D资产,没有地面真实几何,也没有在执行过程中人工矫正.

blocks.en: The framework was evaluated through 35 reconstruction runs, including a reference benchmark of 24 buildings and controlled experiments on reconstruction-specification guidance, input evidence, Astra model configuration, and run-to-run variability. Across the 24 reference cases, FRDS ranged from 0.9126 to 0.9937, with a mean of 0.9647, showing consistently strong agreement between the projected reconstructions and the observed building regions. Comparisons with previous purpose-built LOD3 and DADT approaches showed generally stronger image-space agreement and geometric consistency of a similar order, while AstraLOD3 recovered a richer set of architectural components in several cases. The results are particularly relevant because these models were obtained through a general-purpose multimodal agent rather than a reconstruction pipeline explicitly designed for the considered building datasets.
blocks.zh: 通过35次重建活动对该框架进行了评估,包括24座建筑物的参考基准和关于重建具体化指导、输入证据、Astra模型配置和运行到运行的变异性的有控制的实验。 在24个参考案例中,重建与重建司在0.9126至0.9937之间,平均值为0.9647,显示预测的重建与所观察到的建筑区之间始终一致。 与以往目的建造的LOD3和DADT方法的比较显示,图像空间协议和类似顺序的几何一致性普遍较强,而AstraLOD3在几个案例中恢复了一套更丰富的建筑构件. 这些结果特别重要,因为这些模型是通过通用的多式联运剂而不是专门为考虑的建筑数据集设计的重建管道获得的。

blocks.en: The controlled experiments further clarify the role of the different elements of the framework. Reducing the amount of guidance in ℛ \mathcal{R} changed both the computational trajectory and the interpretation of the reconstruction task, with the Short specification providing the strongest quantitative result for the investigated case and the less constrained Nano specification introducing additional inferred geometry and image-derived textures. The evidence ablation showed that images, calibrated cameras, and sparse geometry provide complementary information: photographs support architectural interpretation and fine detail, point clouds constrain the three-dimensional building geometry, and calibrated cameras connect visual observations to the SfM reference frame. Meaningful reconstructions were nevertheless obtained under substantially reduced evidence, including from the sparse point cloud alone. The Astra model-configuration experiment showed comparatively small qualitative differences between Light , Medium , High , and Extra-High for the principal building geometry, although processing time, refinement behavior, and quantitative agreement varied between executions. Finally, the repeated reconstruction demonstrated that the generated procedural solution is re-executable, but the complete agentic reconstruction process is not deterministic and can follow different computational paths under identical input conditions.
blocks.zh: 受控实验进一步澄清了框架不同要素的作用. 减少 R\ mathcal{R} 中的引导量既改变了计算轨迹,也改变了对重建任务的解释,短规格为调查案件提供了最强的量化结果,而限制较少的纳诺规格引入了额外的推断几何和图像衍生的纹理. 证据表明,图像,校准相机,以及稀疏的几何提供了补充信息:照片支持建筑解释和精细细节,点云约束三维建筑几何,校准相机将视觉观测与SfM参考框架连接. 然而,通过大量减少的证据,包括仅从稀疏的云端获得有意义的重建。 Astra模型配置实验显示,在主要建筑几何学方面,光、中、高和外高之间的质量差异相对较小,尽管处理时间、完善行为和量化协议在处决之间有所不同。 最后,反复的重建表明,产生的程序解决方案是可以重新执行的,但完整的代理重建过程不是决定性的,可以在相同的输入条件下遵循不同的计算路径.

blocks.en: These findings also define the current limitations of AstraLOD3. The quality of the reconstruction remains dependent on the available evidence, particularly for weakly textured roofs, occluded façades, concealed foundations, and other regions that are poorly observed in images or sparse geometry. Individual SfM datasets have arbitrary scale, and residual ground, vegetation, clutter, or damaged material can remain in automatically filtered point clouds and influence geometric evaluation. Similarly, FRDS, D CD D_{\mathrm{CD}} , and IMF measure consistency with the available image and SfM evidence rather than complete three-dimensional accuracy against independent geometric ground truth. The maximum of three geometry-refinement iterations used in this study was introduced to bound computational effort and provide comparable experimental conditions; it should therefore not be interpreted as an intrinsic convergence criterion. Some remaining local errors indicate that additional autonomous refinement could improve individual reconstructions. The controlled ablations are also based primarily on a single building and one independent execution per configuration, and broader repeated experiments are required to characterize statistically the variability associated with reconstruction specifications and model configurations.
blocks.zh: 这些结论还界定了AstraLOD3目前的局限性. 重建的质量仍然取决于现有证据,特别是在纹理薄弱的屋顶、隐蔽的外表、隐蔽的地基以及在图像或几何结构上观测不足的其他地区。 单个的SfM数据集具有任意的尺度,残余的地面,植被,杂质,或受损的材料可以留在自动过滤的点云中,并影响几何评价. 同样,FRDS、D CD D_{\ mathrm{CD}} 和IMF测量与现有图像和SfM证据的一致性,而不是对照独立的几何地面真理完成三维精确度。 本研究采用最多三个几何-精度迭代,用于约束计算努力,并提供可比较的实验条件;因此不应将其解释为内在的趋同标准. 当地仍然存在的一些错误表明,进一步的自主改进可以改善个人重建。 受控浮雕还主要以单座建筑和每个配置一个独立执行为基础,需要进行更广泛的重复试验,从统计上描述与重建规格和模型配置相关的变异性。

blocks.en: Several extensions follow directly from these limitations. Adaptive refinement and stopping criteria could allow the agent to continue reconstruction only when measurable improvements are obtained, reducing unnecessary computation while permitting difficult cases to receive additional attention. A user-in-the-loop mode could retain the generated model, evidence, and reconstruction history and allow targeted instructions for correcting individual openings, roof elements, façades, or other local discrepancies after the autonomous stage. Explicit uncertainty estimates could also be associated with reconstructed components, complementing the current observed/inferred provenance and providing a clearer distinction between directly supported geometry and geometric completion. Additional sensing modalities, including denser geometric observations, could further constrain weakly observed surfaces and reduce ambiguities associated with sparse SfM evidence.
blocks.zh: 几个延长直接源于这些限制。 适应性的改进和停止标准,只有在取得可衡量的改进之后,才能使代理人继续进行重建,减少不必要的计算,同时允许困难案件得到更多的关注。 用户即时操作模式可以保留生成的模型、证据和重建历史,并允许有针对性地指示在自主阶段后纠正单个开口、屋顶元素、外观或其他局部差异。 明确的不确定性估计数也可与重建的组件联系起来,补充目前观察到/推断出的地方,更明确地区分直接支持的几何学和几何学的完成。 包括较密集的几何观测在内的其他遥感方式可能进一步限制观测到的微弱表面,减少与稀少的SfM证据有关的模糊不清之处。

blocks.en: A further research direction is the specialization of the underlying agent for building reconstruction. The present work deliberately establishes a zero-shot baseline using a general-purpose foundation model. Task-specific post-training, fine-tuning, or specialized learned components could subsequently be investigated to improve geometric interpretation, architectural semantics, refinement efficiency, and consistency across repeated runs. Such developments would no longer constitute the same zero-shot setting studied here, but comparison against AstraLOD3 would provide a useful basis for determining how much performance is gained through specialization relative to the general-purpose agentic approach. The framework could also be extended toward damage-aware reconstruction, including explicit representation of damaged roofs, cracks, displaced components, and other post-disaster conditions, as well as integration with structural assessment and digital-twin workflows.
blocks.zh: 另一项研究方向是使建筑重建的基本代理人专业化。 目前的工作是有意利用通用基础模型确定零射线基线。 随后可以调查具体任务的培训后、精细调整或专门学习的组件,以改进几何解释、建筑语义、精细化效率以及反复运行的一致性。 这些发展将不再构成本文所研究的同样的零镜头设定,但与AstraLOD3进行比较,将为确定相对于普通用途代理方法而言,通过专业化取得多少业绩提供一个有益的基础。 该框架还可扩大到对损害的认识重建,包括明确反映受损屋顶、裂缝、流离失所部件和其他灾后情况,并与结构评估和数字双工作流程相结合。

blocks.en: To support further research and reproducibility, the experimental configurations, reconstruction specifications, generated models, procedural scripts, run reports, intermediate results, and evaluation outputs produced in this study will be released publicly, together with the associated benchmark data where redistribution is permitted. Beyond providing the individual reconstruction results, this resource documents how a general-purpose multimodal agent behaves across different buildings, evidence configurations, levels of guidance, and model configurations, and can therefore support future comparisons of agentic reconstruction strategies.
blocks.zh: 为支持进一步研究和再生产,将公布实验配置、重建规格、生成的模型、程序脚本、运行报告、中间结果和本研究产生的评价产出,以及允许重新分配的相关基准数据。 除了提供个别重建成果外,这一资源还记录了通用多式联运代理商在不同建筑物、证据配置、指导水平和模型配置中的表现,因此能够支持今后对代理重建战略的比较。

blocks.en: Overall, AstraLOD3 demonstrates that building-scale LOD3 reconstruction can be formulated as a constrained agentic process rather than only as a fixed geometric pipeline or task-specific learning problem. Within this formulation, a general-purpose multimodal model dynamically selects and combines computational procedures according to the available evidence and reconstruction requirements. The study therefore contributes both a reconstruction framework and an experimental basis for investigating agentic methods in architectural and infrastructure modeling. This direction opens opportunities for more adaptive, interactive, and application-specific generation of structured digital representations for building documentation, inspection, damage assessment, and digital-twin applications.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,AstraLOD3表明,建筑物规模的LOD3重建可作为一种受限的代理过程,而不仅仅是一个固定的几何管道或特定任务的学习问题。 在这一表述中,通用多式联运模式根据现有证据和重建要求,动态地选择和合并计算程序。 因此,这项研究为建筑和基础设施建模中的代理方法的调查提供了重建框架和实验基础。 这一方向为更适应性强、互动性强、应用性强的建筑文献、检查、损害评估和数字双倍应用提供了机会。

blocks.en: You are acting as an autonomous 3D building-reconstruction agent. Use the conda environment ’astralod3’ Your task is to reconstruct the building contained in this dataset as a geometrically consistent, lightweight architectural 3D model using Blender. This is a ZERO-SHOT reconstruction experiment. Do not use external web resources, pretrained building-specific reconstruction pipelines, online assets, or manually downloaded 3D models. You may inspect all files contained in the ’input/<BUILDING>’ directory. INPUTS ------ 1. Multiple calibrated photographs of the same building (input/<BUILDING>/images_sfm/). 2. COLMAP camera intrinsics and extrinsics for these photographs (input/<BUILDING>/sparse). 3. A filtered sparse Structure-from-Motion point cloud representing only the building (input/<BUILDING>/sparse_filtered.ply). OBJECTIVE --------- Generate a detail-enriched but lightweight LOD3 geometric representation of the observed building. The reconstructed model must prioritize: 1. consistency with the supplied SfM geometry; 2. consistency with the supplied images when projected from their corresponding camera poses; 3. preservation of architecturally relevant components; 4. compact geometric representation. ARCHITECTURAL COMPONENTS ------------------------ Model when supported by visual or geometric evidence: - main building envelope; - individual facade planes; - roof geometry; - window openings; - door openings; - simplified window and door frames; - recess depth when visually evident; - balconies; - parapets; - major roof overhangs; - chimneys; - major cornices and facade projections. DO NOT model: - individual bricks; - image textures as geometry; - vegetation; - cables; - furniture; - vehicles; - people; - tiny decorative objects; - geometry that is not relevant to the architectural shape. EVIDENCE RULE ------------- Do not invent architectural components merely because they are common for this architectural style. Every generated architectural component should be supported by at least one input image or by the supplied 3D geometry. Where geometry is genuinely unobservable, use the simplest geometrically reasonable representation. GEOMETRIC REPRESENTATION ------------------------ Use low-poly procedural geometry whenever possible. Prefer: - planar surfaces; - extrusions; - boolean openings; - repeated/instanced components; - simple profile geometry. Avoid unnecessarily dense meshes. CAMERA GEOMETRY --------------- Carefully interpret the COLMAP camera convention before creating Blender cameras. Confirm the world-to-camera / camera-to-world transformation mathematically before using it. Keep all reconstructed geometry in the original SfM coordinate system. Do not independently rescale or arbitrarily rotate the building unless the transformation is explicitly recorded. WORKFLOW -------- Perform the reconstruction using the following stages. STAGE 1 - DATA INSPECTION Inspect: - images; - camera parameters; - point-cloud bounds and distribution. Determine: - principal facade planes; - approximate building envelope; - roof configuration; - visible architectural components. STAGE 2 - RECONSTRUCTION PLAN Before generating final geometry, create: outputs/<BUILDING>/reconstruction_plan.json containing: - inferred building planes; - building dimensions; - roof interpretation; - architectural component inventory; - which input images support each major component. STAGE 3 - BLENDER GENERATION Write a reproducible Blender Python program: outputs/<BUILDING>/build_model.py The entire geometry must be regenerable by running this script from an empty Blender scene. Do not manually edit the resulting Blender file. STAGE 4 - CAMERA VALIDATION Import the supplied cameras into Blender. Render the reconstructed building from representative supplied camera poses. Store validation renders under: outputs/<BUILDING>/validation/iteration_01/ Inspect these renders against the corresponding source photographs. STAGE 5 - SELF-REFINEMENT You may make at most THREE geometry-refinement iterations. For every iteration: 1. modify build_model.py; 2. regenerate the model from an empty scene; 3. render the same validation cameras; 4. inspect geometric inconsistencies. Do not exceed three refinement iterations. STAGE 6 - FINAL OUTPUT Generate: outputs/<BUILDING>/final/model.blend outputs/<BUILDING>/final/model.glb outputs/<BUILDING>/final/model.obj outputs/<BUILDING>/final/build_model.py outputs/<BUILDING>/final/reconstruction.json outputs/<BUILDING>/final/run_report.md reconstruction.json must list every major architectural component with: - component ID; - semantic class; - dimensions; - position; - source image(s) supporting the component; - whether its geometry is directly observed or inferred. run_report.md must document: - files used; - decisions taken; - number of refinement iterations; - geometry statistics; - any unresolved ambiguities. IMPORTANT --------- Do not access files outside the experiment input directory except for software/library dependencies. Do not inspect any ground-truth or evaluation geometry. blocks.en: You are acting as an autonomous 3D building-reconstruction agent.
blocks.zh: 你是一个自主的3D建筑重建代理。

blocks.en: Use the conda environment ’astralod3’
blocks.zh: 使用 Conda 环境 ' ' 说

blocks.en: Your task is to reconstruct the building contained in this dataset as a geometrically consistent, lightweight architectural 3D model using Blender.
blocks.zh: 你的任务是重建这个数据集中包含的建筑,作为使用Blender的几何一致,轻量级的建筑立体模型.

blocks.en: This is a ZERO-SHOT reconstruction experiment. Do not use external web resources, pretrained building-specific reconstruction pipelines, online assets, or manually downloaded 3D models.
blocks.zh: 这是ZERO-SHOT重建实验. 不使用外部网络资源,不使用预先训练的建筑专用重建管道,在线资产,也不使用手动下载的3D模型.

blocks.en: You may inspect all files contained in the ’input/<BUILDING>’ directory.
blocks.zh: 您可查看“ 输入/ < 构建> 目录中的所有文件 。

blocks.en: INPUTS
blocks.zh: 投资

blocks.en: 1. Multiple calibrated photographs of the same building
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 同一建筑物的多张校准照片

blocks.en: (input/<BUILDING>/images_sfm/).
blocks.zh: (投入/<建设>/图像_sfm/)。

blocks.en: 2. COLMAP camera intrinsics and extrinsics for these photographs
blocks.zh: 2. COLMAP照相机的内在和外观

blocks.en: (input/<BUILDING>/sparse).
blocks.zh: (投入/<建设>/sparse)。

blocks.en: 3. A filtered sparse Structure-from-Motion point cloud representing
blocks.zh: 3个 过滤后的稀疏结构点云代表

blocks.en: only the building (input/<BUILDING>/sparse_filtered.ply).
blocks.zh: 只有建筑物(输入/<建构>/sparse_filtered.ply)。

blocks.en: OBJECTIVE
blocks.zh: 目标

blocks.en: Generate a detail-enriched but lightweight LOD3 geometric representation of the observed building.
blocks.zh: 生成一个细节丰富但轻量级的LOD3 观测建筑物的几何表示.

blocks.en: The reconstructed model must prioritize:
blocks.zh: 重建后的模式必须优先:

blocks.en: 1. consistency with the supplied SfM geometry;
blocks.zh: 1. 与所提供的SfM几何学一致;

blocks.en: 2. consistency with the supplied images when projected from their
blocks.zh: 2. 与所提供图像的预测一致

blocks.en: corresponding camera poses;
blocks.zh: 相应的相机姿势;

blocks.en: 3. preservation of architecturally relevant components;
blocks.zh: 3. 保存与建筑有关的部分;

blocks.en: 4. compact geometric representation.
blocks.zh: 4. 紧凑的几何表示。

blocks.en: ARCHITECTURAL COMPONENTS
blocks.zh: 建筑构成部分

blocks.en: Model when supported by visual or geometric evidence:
blocks.zh: 有视觉或几何证据支持的模型:

blocks.en: - main building envelope;
blocks.zh: - 主楼信封;

blocks.en: - individual facade planes;
blocks.zh: - 个别表面飞机;

blocks.en: - roof geometry;
blocks.zh: - 屋顶几何;

blocks.en: - window openings;
blocks.zh: - 开窗;

blocks.en: - door openings;
blocks.zh: - 开门;

blocks.en: - simplified window and door frames;
blocks.zh: - 简化窗口和门框;

blocks.en: - recess depth when visually evident;
blocks.zh: 视力明显时的休眠深度;

blocks.en: - balconies;
blocks.zh: - 瓦房;

blocks.en: - parapets;
blocks.zh: - 栏杆;

blocks.en: - major roof overhangs;
blocks.zh: - 主要屋顶;

blocks.en: - chimneys;
blocks.zh: - 烟囱;

blocks.en: - major cornices and facade projections.
blocks.zh: - 主要的玉米和表面预测。

blocks.en: DO NOT model:
blocks.zh: 不要模式 :

blocks.en: - individual bricks;
blocks.zh: - 个人砖块;

blocks.en: - image textures as geometry;
blocks.zh: - 图像纹理作为几何;

blocks.en: - vegetation;
blocks.zh: - 植被;

blocks.en: - cables;
blocks.zh: - 电缆;

blocks.en: - furniture;
blocks.zh: - 家具;

blocks.en: - vehicles;
blocks.zh: - 车辆;

blocks.en: - people;
blocks.zh: - 人员;

blocks.en: - tiny decorative objects;
blocks.zh: - 小型装饰物品;

blocks.en: - geometry that is not relevant to the architectural shape.
blocks.zh: - 与建筑形状无关的几何学。

blocks.en: EVIDENCE RULE
blocks.zh: 证据规则

blocks.en: Do not invent architectural components merely because they are common for this architectural style.
blocks.zh: 不要仅仅因为建筑构件对于这种建筑风格来说很常见而发明建筑构件.

blocks.en: Every generated architectural component should be supported by at least one input image or by the supplied 3D geometry.
blocks.zh: 每个生成的建筑构件应至少有一个输入图像或提供的3D几何支持.

blocks.en: Where geometry is genuinely unobservable, use the simplest geometrically reasonable representation.
blocks.zh: 在几何学真正不可观察的地方,使用最简单的几何学合理表示.

blocks.en: GEOMETRIC REPRESENTATION
blocks.zh: 格鲁吉亚代表

blocks.en: Use low-poly procedural geometry whenever possible.
blocks.zh: 尽可能使用低孔程序几何.

blocks.en: Prefer:
blocks.zh: 首选:

blocks.en: - planar surfaces;
blocks.zh: - 浮图表面;

blocks.en: - extrusions;
blocks.zh: - 挤压;

blocks.en: - boolean openings;
blocks.zh: - 布尔开口;

blocks.en: - repeated/instanced components;
blocks.zh: - 重复/安装组件;

blocks.en: - simple profile geometry.
blocks.zh: - 简单的剖面几何。

blocks.en: Avoid unnecessarily dense meshes.
blocks.zh: 避免不必要地密集的夹层。

blocks.en: CAMERA GEOMETRY
blocks.zh: 摄影机乔治
曰. 师曰.

blocks.en: Carefully interpret the COLMAP camera convention before creating Blender cameras. Confirm the world-to-camera / camera-to-world transformation mathematically before using it.
blocks.zh: 在创建 Blender 相机前仔细解释 COLMAP 相机会议. 在使用前通过数学确认世界对相机/相机对世界的转换.

blocks.en: Keep all reconstructed geometry in the original SfM coordinate system. Do not independently rescale or arbitrarily rotate the building unless the transformation is explicitly recorded.
blocks.zh: 在原SfM坐标系统中保留所有重建的几何. 除非明确记录转换情况,否则不得独立调整或任意旋转建筑物。

blocks.en: WORKFLOW
blocks.zh: 工作周期

blocks.en: Perform the reconstruction using the following stages.
blocks.zh: 利用以下阶段进行重建。

blocks.en: STAGE 1 - DATA INSPECTION
blocks.zh: 阶段1 - 数据检查

blocks.en: Inspect:
blocks.zh: 检查 :

blocks.en: - images;
blocks.zh: - 图像;

blocks.en: - camera parameters;
blocks.zh: - 照相机参数;

blocks.en: - point-cloud bounds and distribution.
blocks.zh: ——点云界限与分布.

blocks.en: Determine:
blocks.zh: 确定:

blocks.en: - principal facade planes;
blocks.zh: - 主要表面飞机;

blocks.en: - approximate building envelope;
blocks.zh: - 建筑信封;

blocks.en: - roof configuration;
blocks.zh: - 屋顶配置;

blocks.en: - visible architectural components.
blocks.zh: - 可见的建筑构件。

blocks.en: STAGE 2 - RECONSTRUCTION PLAN
blocks.zh: 第2阶段 - 重建计划

blocks.en: Before generating final geometry, create:
blocks.zh: 在生成最后几何之前, 创建 :

blocks.en: outputs/<BUILDING>/reconstruction_plan.json
blocks.zh: 产出/<建构>/重建_计划.json

blocks.en: containing:
blocks.zh: 包含:

blocks.en: - inferred building planes;
blocks.zh: - 推定建造飞机;

blocks.en: - building dimensions;
blocks.zh: - 构筑维度;

blocks.en: - roof interpretation;
blocks.zh: - 屋顶口译;

blocks.en: - architectural component inventory;
blocks.zh: - 建筑部分库存;

blocks.en: - which input images support each major component.
blocks.zh: - 输入图像支持每个主要组件。

blocks.en: STAGE 3 - BLENDER GENERATION
blocks.zh: 第3阶段 -- -- 亮度

blocks.en: Write a reproducible Blender Python program:
blocks.zh: 写入可复制的 Blender Python 程序 :

blocks.en: outputs/<BUILDING>/build_model.py
blocks.zh: 输出/ < Building>/building_model.py

blocks.en: The entire geometry must be regenerable by running this script from an empty Blender scene.
blocks.zh: 整个几何学必须能够通过从一个空的Blender场景中运行这个脚本来重现.

blocks.en: Do not manually edit the resulting Blender file.
blocks.zh: 不要手动编辑产生的 Blender 文件 。

blocks.en: STAGE 4 - CAMERA VALIDATION
blocks.zh: 第4阶段 -- -- 摄影机评估

blocks.en: Import the supplied cameras into Blender.
blocks.zh: 将供应的相机导入Blender.

blocks.en: Render the reconstructed building from representative supplied camera poses.
blocks.zh: 将重建的建筑物从有代表性的摄影机上搬出来。

blocks.en: Store validation renders under:
blocks.zh: 存储验证如下:

blocks.en: outputs/<BUILDING>/validation/iteration_01/
blocks.zh: 产出/<建构>/验证/挖掘_01/

blocks.en: Inspect these renders against the corresponding source photographs.
blocks.zh: 对照相应的原始照片检查这些照片。

blocks.en: STAGE 5 - SELF-REFINEMENT
blocks.zh: 第5阶段 -- -- 自行筹资

blocks.en: You may make at most THREE geometry-refinement iterations.
blocks.zh: 你最多可以做3HEE几何修饰迭代。

blocks.en: For every iteration:
blocks.zh: 每次重复:

blocks.en: 1. modify build_model.py;
blocks.zh: 1. 修改 building_model.py;

blocks.en: 2. regenerate the model from an empty scene;
blocks.zh: 2. 从空景中再生模型;

blocks.en: 3. render the same validation cameras;
blocks.zh: 3. 制作同样的验证相机;

blocks.en: 4. inspect geometric inconsistencies.
blocks.zh: 4. 检查几何不一致之处。

blocks.en: Do not exceed three refinement iterations.
blocks.zh: 不超过三次完善迭代.

blocks.en: STAGE 6 - FINAL OUTPUT
blocks.zh: 阶段6 - 最后结论
